            '      if (!_isChatOpenGenerationCurrent(generation, conversationID)) {\r\n'

            '      unawaited(_syncPeerMessagePermission(forceNetwork: forceNetwork));\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void _syncInFlightOutgoingOnC2cBlocked() {\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || _getConvType() != ConvType.c2c) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final convKey = _getConvID()?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (convKey == null || convKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    C2cBlockedOutgoingMessageSync.markInFlightAsFriendBlocked(\r\n'
            '      conversationID: convKey,\r\n'
            '      globalModel: serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>(),\r\n'
            '      reason: C2cBlockedOutgoingMessageSync.relationBlockedReason,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _syncPeerMessagePermission({bool forceNetwork = false}) async {\r\n'
            '    final peer = _c2cPeerUserId();\r\n'
            '    final requestSeq = _c2cPermission.nextRequestSeq();\r\n'
            '    if (peer == null) {\r\n'
            '      if (_c2cPermission.canMessage != null) {\r\n'
            '        _c2cPermission.canMessage = null;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final cachedSnapshot =\r\n'
            '        !forceNetwork ? C2cFriendMessageGuard.cachedUiSnapshot(peer) : null;\r\n'
            '    final snapshot = cachedSnapshot ??\r\n'
            '        await C2cFriendMessageGuard.refreshUiSnapshot(\r\n'
            '          peer,\r\n'
            '          forceNetwork: forceNetwork,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || requestSeq != _c2cPermission.requestSeq) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_c2cPeerUserId() != peer) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (snapshot.decision == C2cSendPermissionDecision.allowed) {\r\n'
            '      if (_c2cPermission.canMessage != true) {\r\n'
            '        _c2cPermission.canMessage = true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (snapshot.decision == C2cSendPermissionDecision.blocked &&\r\n'
            '        snapshot.relationConfirmed) {\r\n'
            '      _c2cPermission.applyRelationBlocked();\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Fresh became-friends trust must not be overridden by a lagging false.\r\n'
            '  bool _resolveC2cUiCanMessage(String peer, bool canSend) {\r\n'
            '    if (canSend) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (C2cFriendMessageGuard.hasFreshTrustedCanSendHint(peer)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void _attachLocalSettingListener() {\r\n'
            '    final setting = Provider.of<LocalSetting>(context, listen: false);\r\n'
            '    if (_localSetting == setting) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _localSetting?.removeListener(_onLocalSettingChanged);\r\n'
            '    _localSetting = setting;\r\n'
            '    _lastConnectStatus = setting.connectStatusForUi;\r\n'
            '    setting.addListener(_onLocalSettingChanged);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _onLocalSettingChanged() {\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 用 ForUi：connecting 在 debounce 写入 applied 前也能感知断线，\r\n'
            '    // 避免「断线→秒连」时 applied 一直是 success，漏掉 im_reconnected 补拉。\r\n'
            '    final next = _localSetting?.connectStatusForUi;\r\n'
            '    final previous = _lastConnectStatus;\r\n'
            '    _lastConnectStatus = next;\r\n'
            '    if (previous != ConnectStatus.success && next == ConnectStatus.success) {\r\n'
            '      _scheduleReconnectHistoryRecovery();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _scheduleReconnectHistoryRecovery() {\r\n'
            '    final generation = _chatOpenGeneration;\r\n'
            '    final scheduledConversationID = _resolvedConversationID();\r\n'
            '    _reconnectRecoveryTimer?.cancel();\r\n'
            '    _reconnectRecoveryTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 350), () {\r\n'
            '      if (!_isChatOpenGenerationCurrent(generation, scheduledConversationID)) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final conversationId = _resolvedConversationID();\r\n'
            '      if (conversationId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (_latestWindowResetNeeded()) {\r\n'
            '        // Real reconnect while the page is open: the latest-window reset owns\r\n'
            '        // recovery. It repairs immediately when the user is at the bottom and\r\n'
            '        // defers (polling) while history is being read. The anchor-based\r\n'
            '        // catch-up must not compete for the same recovery.\r\n'
            '        _armLatestWindowResetWhenAtBottom(reason: \'im_reconnected\');\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      unawaited(\r\n'
            '        ConversationHistorySyncCoordinator.instance.reconcileConversation(\r\n'
            '          conversationID: conversationId,\r\n'
            '          conversation: _conversation,\r\n'
            '          reason: \'im_reconnected\',\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      ChatHistoryRefreshBus.instance.requestRefresh(\r\n'
            '        conversationId: conversationId,\r\n'
            '        reason: \'im_reconnected\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  String _latestWindowResetKey() {\r\n'
            '    return ConversationPreviewHistorySync.conversationMessageCacheKey(\r\n'
            '          _conversation,\r\n'
            '        ) ??\r\n'
            '        (_getConvID()?.trim() ?? \'\');\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _latestWindowResetNeeded() {\r\n'
            '    final key = _latestWindowResetKey();\r\n'
            '    if (key.isEmpty) return false;\r\n'
            '    final service = ChatLatestWindowResetService.instance;\r\n'
            '    return service.needsLatestWindowReset(key) || service.isResetInFlight(key);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// In-page latest-window repair. One operation per conversation; the\r\n'
            '  /// service polls until the user is at the bottom and re-checks position\r\n'
            '  /// after the network round trip before touching the visible timeline.\r\n'
            '  void _armLatestWindowResetWhenAtBottom({required String reason}) {\r\n'
            '    final key = _latestWindowResetKey();\r\n'
            '    if (key.isEmpty) return;\r\n'
            '    final generation = _chatOpenGeneration;\r\n'
            '    final scheduledConversationID = _resolvedConversationID();\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '    final openGeneration = _viewportOpenGeneration > 0\r\n'
            '        ? _viewportOpenGeneration\r\n'
            '        : ChatViewportCollection.instance.openGenerationFor(key);\r\n'
            '    ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '      \'latest_window_reset_armed\',\r\n'
            '      source: reason,\r\n'
            '      conversationID: scheduledConversationID,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'epoch\': ImConnectStatusService.recoveryEpoch,\r\n'
            '        \'openGeneration\': openGeneration,\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    unawaited(() async {\r\n'
            '      final latestPreview = await _fetchConversationPreviewLastMessage();\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '          !_isChatOpenGenerationCurrent(generation, scheduledConversationID)) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final conversation = V2TimConversation.fromJson(_conversation.toJson())\r\n'
            '        ..lastMessage = latestPreview ?? _conversation.lastMessage;\r\n'
            '      final outcome = await ChatLatestWindowResetService.instance.runInPage(\r\n'
            '        conversation: conversation,\r\n'
            '        globalModel: globalModel,\r\n'
            '        openGeneration: openGeneration,\r\n'
            '        reason: reason,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '          !_isChatOpenGenerationCurrent(generation, scheduledConversationID)) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '        \'latest_window_reset_result\',\r\n'
            '        source: reason,\r\n'
            '        conversationID: scheduledConversationID,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\'outcome\': outcome.name},\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (outcome == LatestWindowResetOutcome.trusted ||\r\n'
            '          outcome == LatestWindowResetOutcome.installedProvisional) {\r\n'
            '        _publishExternalEntryState();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }());\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 打开群聊后异步纠偏：本地群资料里的真实 `@TGS#_mc…` 覆盖错误加成 ID。\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _resolveImGroupIdAfterOpen() async {\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() != ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final raw = _conversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (raw.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final generation = _chatOpenGeneration;\r\n'
            '    final conversationID = _resolvedConversationID();\r\n'
            '    final resolved = await GroupLocalStore.instance.resolveImGroupId(raw);\r\n'
            '    if (!_isChatOpenGenerationCurrent(generation, conversationID) ||\r\n'
            '        resolved.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final current = ChatIdFormat.normalizeGroupId(raw);\r\n'
            '    if (resolved == current) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 仅当解析出不同真源（常见：m2 短码 → @TGS#_mc…）时改写。\r\n'
            '    setState(() {\r\n'
            '      _conversation.groupID = resolved;\r\n'
            '      _conversation.conversationID = \'group_$resolved\';\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  V2TimConversation _normalizedConversationForChat(\r\n'
            '    V2TimConversation conversation,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final resolvedConversationID = _resolvedConversationID(conversation);\r\n'
            '    if (resolvedConversationID.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        conversation.conversationID.trim().isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      conversation.conversationID = resolvedConversationID;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final rawGroupId = conversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (rawGroupId.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        (conversation.type == 2 ||\r\n'
            '            rawGroupId.toUpperCase().contains(\'TGS#\') ||\r\n'
            '            ChatIdFormat.isIMGroupOrCommunityId(rawGroupId))) {\r\n'
            '      // 优先本地群资料真源（@TGS#_mc…），避免 displayAlias 短码加成成不存在的\r\n'
            '      // @TGS#_@TGS#m2…（rizhi：10010 / 6017）。\r\n'
            '      final cached = GroupLocalStore.instance.readCached(groupId: rawGroupId);\r\n'
            '      if ((conversation.groupType?.trim().isEmpty ?? true) &&\r\n'
            '          cached?.groupType.trim().isNotEmpty == true) {\r\n'
            '        // 首屏历史路由使用已缓存的权威群类型；ID 形态不能把普通群误判为 Community。\r\n'
            '        conversation.groupType = cached!.groupType.trim();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final fromStore = cached == null\r\n'
            '          ? \'\'\r\n'
            '          : ChatIdFormat.imGroupIdFromRecord(\r\n'
            '              groupId: cached.groupId,\r\n'
            '              displayAlias: cached.displayAlias,\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '      final normalizedGroupId = fromStore.isNotEmpty\r\n'
            '          ? fromStore\r\n'
            '          : ChatIdFormat.canonicalGroupStorageId(rawGroupId);\r\n'
            '      if (normalizedGroupId.isNotEmpty && normalizedGroupId != rawGroupId) {\r\n'
            '        conversation.groupID = normalizedGroupId;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final gid = conversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (gid.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        final wantConvId = \'group_$gid\';\r\n'
            '        final curConvId = conversation.conversationID.trim();\r\n'
            '        if (curConvId.isEmpty ||\r\n'
            '            (curConvId.toLowerCase().startsWith(\'group_\') &&\r\n'
            '                curConvId != wantConvId &&\r\n'
            '                !ChatIdFormat.groupIdsEquivalent(curConvId, wantConvId))) {\r\n'
            '          // 仅在会话 ID 仍是错误加成形态时改写，避免无谓抖动。\r\n'
            '          final bare = curConvId.toLowerCase().startsWith(\'group_\')\r\n'
            '              ? curConvId.substring(6)\r\n'
            '              : curConvId;\r\n'
            '          if (bare.isEmpty ||\r\n'
            '              ChatIdFormat.apiGroupId(bare) == ChatIdFormat.apiGroupId(gid) ||\r\n'
            '              ChatIdFormat.looksLikeCommunityGroupId(bare)) {\r\n'
            '            conversation.conversationID = wantConvId;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } else if (rawGroupId.isEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        conversation.conversationID.trim().toLowerCase().startsWith(\'group_\')) {\r\n'
            '      final fromConv = ChatIdFormat.canonicalGroupStorageId(\r\n'
            '        conversation.conversationID,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      final cached = fromConv.isEmpty\r\n'
            '          ? null\r\n'
            '          : GroupLocalStore.instance.readCached(groupId: fromConv);\r\n'
            '      final fromStore = cached == null\r\n'
            '          ? \'\'\r\n'
            '          : ChatIdFormat.imGroupIdFromRecord(\r\n'
            '              groupId: cached.groupId,\r\n'
            '              displayAlias: cached.displayAlias,\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '      final resolved = fromStore.isNotEmpty ? fromStore : fromConv;\r\n'
            '      if (resolved.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        conversation.groupID = resolved;\r\n'
            '        conversation.conversationID = \'group_$resolved\';\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return conversation;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'

            '  Future<void> _persistChatLocalDraftText(\r\n'
            '    String text,\r\n'
            '    int generation, {\r\n'
            '    String? conversationID,\r\n'
            '    bool enforceCurrentGeneration = true,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    final conversationId = (conversationID ?? _resolvedConversationID()).trim();\r\n'
            '    if (conversationId.isEmpty) {\r\n'

            '    await _draftWrites.enqueue(\r\n'
            '      () async {\r\n'
            '        if (enforceCurrentGeneration && _draft.shouldSuppressLifecyclePersist) {\r\n'
            '          ConversationDraftLeaveTrace.stage(\r\n'
            '            \'draft_persist_skipped\',\r\n'
            '            conversationId: conversationId,\r\n'
            '            extras: const <String, Object?>{\'reason\': \'suppress\'},\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '          return;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (enforceCurrentGeneration && generation != _draft.writeGeneration) {\r\n'
            '          ConversationDraftLeaveTrace.stage(\r\n'
            '            \'draft_persist_skipped\',\r\n'
            '            conversationId: conversationId,\r\n'
            '            extras: const <String, Object?>{\'reason\': \'generation\'},\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '          return;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (_isCurrentConversation(conversationId)) {\r\n'
            '          _draft.text = text.trim().isEmpty ? null : text;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        ConversationDraftLeaveTrace.stage(\r\n'
            '          \'draft_persist_enqueue_run\',\r\n'
            '          conversationId: conversationId,\r\n'
            '          draftText: text,\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'generation\': generation,\r\n'
            '            \'suppress\': _draft.shouldSuppressLifecyclePersist,\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        await ConversationDraftService.instance.persistDraft(\r\n'
            '          conversationID: conversationId,\r\n'
            '          rawInputText: text,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '      onError: (error, stackTrace) {\r\n'
            '        debugPrint(\r\n'
            '          \'[ChatDraft] persist failed conv=$conversationId error=$error\\n\'\r\n'
            '          \'$stackTrace\',\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _onChatDraftTextChanged(String text) {\r\n'

            '  /// 与输入栏禁言逻辑一致：群主/管理员始终可发言；全员禁言或个人禁言则不可发言。\r\n'

            '  Future<void> _refreshChatGroupMuteState() async {\r\n'
            '    final groupId = widget.selectedConversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (groupId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 先应用后端/TCP 权威禁言状态，避免先渲染旧 SDK 状态导致输入栏闪回禁言。\r\n'
            '    await _fetchAndStoreBackendMuteStatus(groupId);\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// 获取并存储后端禁言状态到 GroupMemberStore\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _fetchAndStoreBackendMuteStatus(String groupId) {\r\n'
            '    return _openLifecycle.muteRefreshQueue.refresh((requestIsCurrent) async {\r\n'
            '      final muteGeneration = _openLifecycle.muteFetchGeneration;\r\n'
            '      final owner = GroupLocalStore.instance.currentOwnerUserId();\r\n'
            '      bool isCurrent() =>\r\n'
            '          mounted &&\r\n'
            '          requestIsCurrent() &&\r\n'
            '          muteGeneration == _openLifecycle.muteFetchGeneration &&\r\n'
            '          owner == GroupLocalStore.instance.currentOwnerUserId() &&\r\n'
            '          ChatIdFormat.groupIdsEquivalent(\r\n'
            '            groupId, widget.selectedConversation.groupID,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '      if (!isCurrent()) return;\r\n'
            '      final muteSw = Stopwatch()..start();\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        final muteStatus = await MeGroupApi.instance.fetchMyMuteStatus(groupId);\r\n'
            '        if (!isCurrent()) return;\r\n'
            '        ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '          \'mute_network_fetch_done\',\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'muteMs\': muteSw.elapsedMilliseconds,\r\n'
            '            \'hasStatus\': muteStatus != null,\r\n'
            '            \'isAllMuted\': muteStatus?.isAllMuted,\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        if (muteStatus == null) return;\r\n'
            '        await GroupLocalStore.instance.patch(\r\n'
            '          ownerUserId: owner,\r\n'
            '          groupId: groupId,\r\n'
            '          transform: (current) => isCurrent()\r\n'
            '              ? current.copyWith(isAllMuted: muteStatus.isAllMuted)\r\n'
            '              : current,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        if (!isCurrent()) return;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '        Future<bool> applyToModel() async {\r\n'
            '          final model = _chatController.model;\r\n'
            '          if (model == null || !isCurrent()) return false;\r\n'
            '          await model.updateSelfMuteStatus(\r\n'
            '            groupID: groupId,\r\n'
            '            muteUntil: muteStatus.muteUntil,\r\n'
            '            isAllMuted: muteStatus.isAllMuted,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '          return true;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '        if (await applyToModel()) return;\r\n'
            '        // The model may not exist yet during the first page frame.\r\n'
            '        for (final delay in const <Duration>[\r\n'
            '          Duration(milliseconds: 80),\r\n'
            '          Duration(milliseconds: 200),\r\n'
            '          Duration(milliseconds: 500),\r\n'
            '        ]) {\r\n'
            '          await Future<void>.delayed(delay);\r\n'
            '          if (!isCurrent()) return;\r\n'
            '          if (await applyToModel()) return;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {\r\n'
            '        // Keep the last known state. The queue remains available for a later\r\n'
            '        // event, including one that arrived during this failed request.\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _cancelChatOpenSideEffects({\r\n'
            '    required String reason,\r\n'
            '    bool resumeWarm = true,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    _openLifecycle.cancelPendingMuteFetch();\r\n'
            '    _chatController.model?.cancelOpenSideMemberLoads();\r\n'
            '    if (!resumeWarm) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (ConversationPerfFlags.historyWarmDeferResumeAfterChatLeave) {\r\n'
            '      ConversationHistoryWarmScheduler.instance.resumeAfterActiveChat(\r\n'
            '        reason: reason,\r\n'
            '        deferIncompleteWarm: true,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    ConversationHistoryWarmScheduler.instance.resumeAfterActiveChat(\r\n'
            '      reason: reason,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 栈内仍开着 Chat 时登记/恢复 ActiveChat。被资料页盖住时只改 routeVisible，不 leave。\r\n'
            '  void _restoreActiveChatRegistry({bool routeVisible = true}) {\r\n'
            '    final id = _resolvedConversationID();\r\n'
            '    if (id.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final current = ActiveChatRegistry.instance.activeConversationId;\r\n'
            '    if (current == null ||\r\n'
            '        !MessageConversationId.sameConversation(current, id)) {\r\n'
            '      ActiveChatRegistry.instance.enter(\r\n'
            '        id,\r\n'
            '        routeVisible: routeVisible,\r\n'
            '        conversationType: _getConvType(),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    ActiveChatRegistry.instance.updateRouteVisible(routeVisible);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// pop 发起瞬间（过渡动画之前）先把聊天期间挂起的列表投影/通知刷出去，\r\n'
            '  /// 让返回动画第一帧就是新预览；dispose 里的草稿链路兜底不变。\r\n'

            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 离开 Chat 后交还列表：默认只 patch 刚离开会话，并 flush 进聊期间挂起的 Feed notify。\r\n'
            '  void _flushConversationListUiAfterChatLeave({\r\n'

            '        ),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _warmAvatarsOnChatOpen() async {\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final faces = <String?>[\r\n'
            '      _conversation.faceUrl,\r\n'
            '      widget.selectedConversation.faceUrl,\r\n'
            '      _cachedHeaderFaceUrl,\r\n'
            '    ];\r\n'
            '    final convKey = _getConvID()?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (convKey.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final messages =\r\n'
            '          serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>().messageListMap[convKey];\r\n'
            '      if (messages != null) {\r\n'
            '        final limit = messages.length < 30 ? messages.length : 30;\r\n'
            '        for (var i = 0; i < limit; i++) {\r\n'
            '          final message = messages[i];\r\n'
            '          faces.add(message.faceUrl);\r\n'
            '          if (_getConvType() == ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '            final groupId = widget.selectedConversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '            final sender = (message.sender ?? message.userID ?? \'\').trim();\r\n'
            '            if (groupId.isNotEmpty && sender.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '              faces.add(\r\n'
            '                GroupMemberStore.instance.memberOf(groupId, sender)?.faceUrl,\r\n'
            '              );\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final isGroup = _getConvType() == ConvType.group;\r\n'
            '    await AvatarImageWarm.warmSources(\r\n'
            '      [\r\n'
            '        if (isGroup)\r\n'
            '          GroupAvatarSource.fromCached(\r\n'
            '            groupId: widget.selectedConversation.groupID ?? convKey,\r\n'
            '            fallbackUrl: _cachedHeaderFaceUrl ?? _conversation.faceUrl ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '          ).warmSource(),\r\n'
            '        ...faces.skip(isGroup ? 3 : 0).map(\r\n'
            '              (url) => AvatarImageWarmSource(url: url),\r\n'
            '            ),\r\n'
            '      ],\r\n'
            '      context: context,\r\n'
            '      logicalSize: 40,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _releaseBubbleCacheAndWarmListAvatar() {\r\n'
            '    final convKey = _getConvID()?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final messages = convKey.isEmpty\r\n'
            '        ? const <V2TimMessage>[]\r\n'
            '        : (serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>().messageListMap[convKey] ??\r\n'
            '            const <V2TimMessage>[]);\r\n'
            '    // 路由 pop 中同步驱逐 ImageCache 会抢占主线程，列表首帧后再按批释放。\r\n'
            '    ChatImageMessagePrefetch.evictBubbleCacheForMessagesAfterFrame(messages);\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logImageCache(\r\n'
            '      \'chat_leave_bubble_evict_scheduled\',\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\'rawMessageCount\': messages.length},\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    ChatResourceSample.onLeave(rawMessageCount: messages.length);\r\n'
            '    // 会话列表在 Navigator.pop 返回后用自身仍有效的 context 预热头像；\r\n'
            '    // 此处的 Chat context 已进入 dispose，不再启动跨帧图片任务。\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _refreshChatGroupMembers(\r\n'
            '    String groupId, {\r\n'
            '    List<String> userIds = const <String>[],\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    final model = _chatController.model;\r\n'

            '      return;\r\n'

            '    // 无定点 uid 时不再跑 open-shell / 整表成员拉取，成员关系走 IM SDK。\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _muteGroupMemberFromChat({\r\n'
            '    required String groupId,\r\n'
            '    required String targetId,\r\n'
            '    required String displayName,\r\n'
            '    required bool mute,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    final confirmed = await AppDialog.confirm(\r\n'
            '      title: AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '        zhHans: mute ? \'禁言成员\' : \'解除禁言\',\r\n'
            '        zhHant: mute ? \'禁言成員\' : \'解除禁言\',\r\n'
            '        en: mute ? \'Mute Member\' : \'Unmute Member\',\r\n'
            '        ja: mute ? \'メンバーをミュート\' : \'ミュート解除\',\r\n'
            '        ko: mute ? \'멤버 채팅 금지\' : \'채팅 금지 해제\',\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '      message: AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '        zhHans: mute ? \'确定禁言「$displayName」吗？\' : \'确定解除「$displayName」的禁言吗？\',\r\n'
            '        zhHant: mute ? \'確定禁言「$displayName」嗎？\' : \'確定解除「$displayName」的禁言嗎？\',\r\n'
            '        en: mute ? \'Mute "$displayName"?\' : \'Unmute "$displayName"?\',\r\n'
            '        ja: mute ? \'「$displayName」をミュートしますか？\' : \'「$displayName」のミュートを解除しますか？\',\r\n'
            '        ko: mute\r\n'
            '            ? \'"$displayName" 님을 채팅 금지하시겠습니까?\'\r\n'
            '            : \'"$displayName" 님의 채팅 금지를 해제하시겠습니까?\',\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '      destructive: mute,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (!confirmed || !mounted) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final hud = AppHud.begin();\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      const muteTime = 315360000;\r\n'
            '      final groupServices = serviceLocator<GroupServices>();\r\n'
            '      final res = await groupServices.muteGroupMember(\r\n'
            '        groupID: groupId,\r\n'
            '        userID: targetId,\r\n'
            '        seconds: mute ? muteTime : 0,\r\n'

            '              ? desc\r\n'
            '              : AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '                  zhHans: \'操作失败\',\r\n'
            '                  zhHant: \'操作失敗\',\r\n'
            '                  en: \'Operation failed\',\r\n'
            '                  ja: \'操作に失敗しました\',\r\n'
            '                  ko: \'작업에 실패했습니다\',\r\n'
            '                ),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      await _refreshChatGroupMembers(groupId, userIds: <String>[targetId]);\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      ToastUtils.toast(\r\n'
            '        AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '          zhHans: mute ? \'已禁言\' : \'已解除禁言\',\r\n'
            '          zhHant: mute ? \'已禁言\' : \'已解除禁言\',\r\n'
            '          en: mute ? \'Member muted\' : \'Member unmuted\',\r\n'
            '          ja: mute ? \'ミュートしました\' : \'ミュートを解除しました\',\r\n'
            '          ko: mute ? \'채팅 금지되었습니다\' : \'채팅 금지가 해제되었습니다\',\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    } finally {\r\n'
            '      await hud.end();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _kickGroupMemberFromChat({\r\n'
            '    required String groupId,\r\n'
            '    required String targetId,\r\n'
            '    required String displayName,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    final confirmed = await AppDialog.confirm(\r\n'
            '      title: AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '        zhHans: \'移出群聊\',\r\n'
            '        zhHant: \'移出群聊\',\r\n'
            '        en: \'Remove from Group\',\r\n'
            '        ja: \'グループから削除\',\r\n'
            '        ko: \'그룹에서보내기\',\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '      message: AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '        zhHans: \'确定将「$displayName」移出群聊吗？\',\r\n'
            '        zhHant: \'確定將「$displayName」移出群聊嗎？\',\r\n'
            '        en: \'Remove "$displayName" from this group?\',\r\n'
            '        ja: \'「$displayName」をグループから削除しますか？\',\r\n'

            '    try {\r\n'
            '      final groupServices = serviceLocator<GroupServices>();\r\n'
            '      final res = await groupServices.kickGroupMember(\r\n'
            '        groupID: groupId,\r\n'
            '        memberList: [targetId],\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'

            '        if (!mounted) return;\r\n'

            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _onLongPressOthersAvatar(\r\n'
            '    String? userId,\r\n'
            '    String? nickName,\r\n'
            '  ) async {\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() != ConvType.group) return;\r\n'
            '    final targetId = userId?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (targetId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _chatController.mentionOtherMemberInGroup(\r\n'
            '        showNameInMessage: \'\',\r\n'
            '        userID: \'\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final loginUserId =\r\n'
            '        TIMUIKitCore.getInstance().loginUserInfo?.userID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (targetId == loginUserId) return;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (PlatformOfficialAccountService.isPlatformOfficialAccount(targetId) ||\r\n'
            '        PlatformOfficialAccountService.isOfficialAccountUserId(targetId)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final groupId = _getConvID()?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final V2TimGroupMemberFullInfo member;\r\n'
            '    final String displayName;\r\n'
            '    final String avatar;\r\n'
            '    final V2TimGroupInfo? groupInfo;\r\n'
            '    final int serverTime;\r\n'
            '    final hud = AppHud.begin();\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      var resolvedMember = _findGroupMemberByUserId(targetId);\r\n'
            '      if (resolvedMember == null && groupId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        await _refreshChatGroupMembers(groupId, userIds: <String>[targetId]);\r\n'
            '        if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '          return;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        resolvedMember = _findGroupMemberByUserId(targetId);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (resolvedMember == null) {\r\n'
            '        ToastUtils.toast(\r\n'
            '          AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '            zhHans: \'该用户已退出群聊\',\r\n'
            '            zhHant: \'該用戶已退出群聊\',\r\n'
            '            en: \'This user has left the group\',\r\n'
            '            ja: \'このユーザーはグループを退会しました\',\r\n'
            '            ko: \'해당 사용자가 그룹을 나갔습니다\',\r\n'
            '          ),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      member = resolvedMember;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      displayName = _resolveGroupMemberDisplayName(\r\n'
            '        userId: targetId,\r\n'
            '        nickName: nickName,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      avatar = UserAvatarHelper.pickBest(imFaceUrl: member.faceUrl);\r\n'
            '      groupInfo = _currentGroupInfo();\r\n'
            '      serverTime = await _fetchImServerTime();\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      // 无发言权限（被禁言的普通成员）：长按头像不可操作。\r\n'
            '      // 群主/管理员不受禁言影响，仍可弹出菜单。\r\n'
            '      if (!_canCurrentUserSpeakInGroup(serverTime: serverTime)) {\r\n'
            '        ToastUtils.toast(\r\n'
            '          AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '            zhHans: \'禁言状态下无法操作\',\r\n'
            '            zhHant: \'禁言狀態下無法操作\',\r\n'
            '            en: \'Unavailable while muted\',\r\n'
            '            ja: \'ミュート中は操作できません\',\r\n'
            '            ko: \'채팅 금지 상태에서는 사용할 수 없습니다\',\r\n'
            '          ),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } finally {\r\n'
            '      await hud.end();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final canMute = groupInfo != null &&\r\n'
            '        groupId.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        _canMuteTargetGroupMember(groupInfo, member);\r\n'
            '    final canKick = groupInfo != null &&\r\n'
            '        groupId.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        _canKickTargetGroupMember(groupInfo, member);\r\n'
            '    final isMuted = canMute\r\n'
            '        ? _isGroupMemberCurrentlyMuted(member, serverTime: serverTime)\r\n'
            '        : false;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final action = await showCupertinoModalPopup<String>(\r\n'
            '      context: context,\r\n'
            '      builder: (sheetContext) {\r\n'
            '        final sheetActions = <CupertinoActionSheetAction>[\r\n'
            '          CupertinoActionSheetAction(\r\n'
            '            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, \'at\'),\r\n'
            '            child: Text(\r\n'
            '              AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '                zhHans: \'@他\',\r\n'
            '                zhHant: \'@他\',\r\n'
            '                en: \'@ Them\',\r\n'
            '                ja: \'@する\',\r\n'
            '                ko: \'@멘션\',\r\n'
            '              ),\r\n'
            '            ),\r\n'
            '          ),\r\n'
            '          CupertinoActionSheetAction(\r\n'
            '            onPressed: () =>\r\n'
            '                Navigator.pop(sheetContext, \'exclusive_red_packet\'),\r\n'
            '            child: Text(\r\n'
            '              AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '                zhHans: \'专属红包\',\r\n'
            '                zhHant: \'專屬紅包\',\r\n'
            '                en: \'Exclusive Red Packet\',\r\n'
            '                ja: \'専用お年玉\',\r\n'
            '                ko: \'전용 홍바오\',\r\n'
            '              ),\r\n'
            '            ),\r\n'
            '          ),\r\n'
            '        ];\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '        if (canMute) {\r\n'
            '          sheetActions.add(\r\n'
            '            CupertinoActionSheetAction(\r\n'
            '              onPressed: () =>\r\n'
            '                  Navigator.pop(sheetContext, isMuted ? \'unmute\' : \'mute\'),\r\n'
            '              child: Text(\r\n'
            '                AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '                  zhHans: isMuted ? \'解除禁言\' : \'禁言\',\r\n'
            '                  zhHant: isMuted ? \'解除禁言\' : \'禁言\',\r\n'
            '                  en: isMuted ? \'Unmute\' : \'Mute\',\r\n'
            '                  ja: isMuted ? \'ミュート解除\' : \'ミュート\',\r\n'
            '                  ko: isMuted ? \'채팅 금지 해제\' : \'채팅 금지\',\r\n'
            '                ),\r\n'
            '              ),\r\n'
            '            ),\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (canKick) {\r\n'
            '          sheetActions.add(\r\n'
            '            CupertinoActionSheetAction(\r\n'
            '              isDestructiveAction: true,\r\n'
            '              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, \'kick\'),\r\n'
            '              child: Text(\r\n'
            '                AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '                  zhHans: \'移出群聊\',\r\n'
            '                  zhHant: \'移出群聊\',\r\n'
            '                  en: \'Remove from Group\',\r\n'
            '                  ja: \'グループから削除\',\r\n'
            '                  ko: \'그룹에서보내기\',\r\n'
            '                ),\r\n'
            '              ),\r\n'
            '            ),\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '        return CupertinoActionSheet(\r\n'
            '          actions: sheetActions,\r\n'
            '          cancelButton: CupertinoActionSheetAction(\r\n'
            '            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext),\r\n'
            '            child: Text(\r\n'
            '              AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '                zhHans: \'取消\',\r\n'
            '                zhHant: \'取消\',\r\n'
            '                en: \'Cancel\',\r\n'
            '                ja: \'キャンセル\',\r\n'
            '                ko: \'취소\',\r\n'
            '              ),\r\n'
            '            ),\r\n'
            '          ),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || action == null) return;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    switch (action) {\r\n'
            '      case \'at\':\r\n'
            '        _mentionMemberInGroup(userId: targetId, nickName: nickName);\r\n'
            '        break;\r\n'
            '      case \'exclusive_red_packet\':\r\n'

            '  Future<void> _openWalletTransfer() async {\r\n'
            '    final convId = _getConvID() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isEmpty) return;\r\n'
            '    final isGroup = _getConvType() == ConvType.group;\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '    _dismissChatInput();\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void _onWalletChatCard() {\r\n'
            '    final data = WalletOrderEvents.chatCardPayload.value;\r\n'
            '    if (data == null || data.isEmpty) return;\r\n'
            '    unawaited(_handleWalletChatCardEvent(Map<String, dynamic>.from(data)));\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _handleWalletChatCardEvent(Map<String, dynamic> data) async {\r\n'
            '    final orderId = data[\'orderId\']?.toString() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final clientOrderId = data[\'clientOrderId\']?.toString() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final event = data[WalletOrderEvents.walletCardEventKey]?.toString() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final already = await WalletCardReplayGuard.instance.alreadySent(\r\n'
            '      orderId: orderId,\r\n'
            '      clientOrderId: clientOrderId,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // C 兜底：无事件类型时，已发送当 cardSent；否则当 cardNeedSend。\r\n'
            '    final treatAsSent = event == WalletOrderEvents.cardSent ||\r\n'
            '        (event.isEmpty && already) ||\r\n'
            '        (already && event != WalletOrderEvents.cardNeedSend);\r\n'
            '    final treatAsNeedSend = event == WalletOrderEvents.cardNeedSend ||\r\n'
            '        (event.isEmpty && !already);\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (treatAsSent) {\r\n'
            '      await _onWalletCardSentEvent(data);\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (treatAsNeedSend) {\r\n'
            '      final source = _walletCardSendSourceOf(\r\n'
            '        data,\r\n'
            '        fallback: WalletCardSendSource.payment,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      await _sendWalletCardWithStatus(data, source: source);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _onWalletCardSentEvent(Map<String, dynamic> data) async {\r\n'
            '    WalletCardDispatchService.instance.removeMatching(data);\r\n'
            '    await _walletCardSendSvc.markSent(data);\r\n'
            '    final mark = _walletCardMark(data);\r\n'
            '    final payloadConvId = data[\'conversationId\']?.toString().trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final convId =\r\n'
            '        payloadConvId.isNotEmpty ? payloadConvId : (_getConvID() ?? \'\');\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isNotEmpty && mark.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _walletOutbound.sentMarksFor(convId).add(mark);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _onWalletChatCardSendFailed() {\r\n'
            '    final data = WalletOrderEvents.chatCardSendFailedPayload.value;\r\n'
            '    if (data == null || data.isEmpty) return;\r\n'
            '    if (data[\'manualRequired\'] != true) return;\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\r\n'
            '    if (!WalletOrderEvents.claimChatCardFailNotice(data)) return;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final retryCount = data[\'retryCount\']?.toString() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final tip = retryCount.isEmpty\r\n'
            '        ? AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '            zhHans: \'钱包消息发送失败，可重新发送\',\r\n'
            '            zhHant: \'錢包訊息傳送失敗，可重新傳送\',\r\n'
            '            en: \'Wallet message failed to send. Tap to resend.\',\r\n'
            '            ja: \'ウォレットメッセージの送信に失敗しました。再送信できます。\',\r\n'
            '            ko: \'지갑 메시지 전송 실패. 다시 보낼 수 있습니다.\',\r\n'
            '          )\r\n'
            '        : AppI18n.of(context).format(\r\n'
            '            zhHans: \'钱包消息发送失败，已重试{option1}次\',\r\n'
            '            zhHant: \'錢包訊息傳送失敗，已重試{option1}次\',\r\n'
            '            en: \'Wallet message failed after {option1} retries\',\r\n'
            '            ja: \'ウォレットメッセージの送信に失敗（{option1}回再試行）\',\r\n'
            '            ko: \'지갑 메시지 전송 실패 ({option1}회 재시도)\',\r\n'
            '            vars: {\'option1\': retryCount.toString()},\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    AppDialog.showNotice(\r\n'
            '      title: AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '        zhHans: \'钱包消息\',\r\n'
            '        zhHant: \'錢包訊息\',\r\n'
            '        en: \'Wallet message\',\r\n'
            '        ja: \'ウォレットメッセージ\',\r\n'
            '        ko: \'지갑 메시지\',\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '      message: tip,\r\n'
            '      actionText: AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '        zhHans: \'重新发送\',\r\n'
            '        zhHant: \'重新傳送\',\r\n'
            '        en: \'Resend\',\r\n'
            '        ja: \'再送信\',\r\n'
            '        ko: \'다시 보내기\',\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '      duration: const Duration(seconds: 6),\r\n'
            '      onTap: () => _retryManualWalletCard(data),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _retryManualWalletCard(Map<String, dynamic> data) async {\r\n'
            '    final payload = await _walletCardSendSvc.resetForManualSend(data);\r\n'
            '    if (payload == null) return;\r\n'
            '    await WalletCardReplayGuard.instance.resetForManual(\r\n'
            '      orderId: payload[\'orderId\']?.toString() ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '      clientOrderId: payload[\'clientOrderId\']?.toString() ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    await _sendWalletCardWithStatus(\r\n'
            '      payload,\r\n'
            '      source: WalletCardSendSource.manual,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _retryWalletCardsForConversation({\r\n'
            '    WalletCardSendSource source = WalletCardSendSource.payment,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    final convId = _getConvID() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isEmpty || !_walletOutbound.beginRetry(convId)) return;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      final dispatched = WalletCardDispatchService.instance.takeForConversation(\r\n'
            '        convId,\r\n'
            '        limit: 5,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      for (var i = 0; i < dispatched.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '        if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '          for (var j = i; j < dispatched.length; j++) {\r\n'
            '            WalletCardDispatchService.instance.enqueue(dispatched[j]);\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          return;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        await _sendWalletCardWithStatus(\r\n'
            '          dispatched[i],\r\n'
            '          source: _walletCardSendSourceOf(dispatched[i], fallback: source),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 250));\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      if (source == WalletCardSendSource.autoRetry) {\r\n'
            '        source = WalletCardSendSource.recovery;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      final payloads = await _walletCardSendSvc.retryPayloadsForConversation(\r\n'
            '        convId,\r\n'
            '        limit: 5,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      for (final payload in payloads) {\r\n'
            '        if (!mounted) return;\r\n'
            '        await _sendWalletCardWithStatus(payload, source: source);\r\n'
            '        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 250));\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } finally {\r\n'
            '      _walletOutbound.endRetry(convId);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  @Deprecated(\r\n'
            '    \'Use ChatHistoryRecoveryCoordinator.schedulePostOpenRetry instead\',\r\n'
            '  )\r\n'
            '  void _retryLoadedFailedChatMessages() {\r\n'
            '    final convId = _resolvedConversationID();\r\n'
            '    final convKey = _conversationRecoveryKey();\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isEmpty || convKey.isEmpty) return;\r\n'
            '    ChatHistoryRecoveryCoordinator.instance.schedulePostOpenRetry(\r\n'
            '      conversationKey: convKey,\r\n'
            '      conversationID: convId,\r\n'
            '      conversationType: _getConvType(),\r\n'
            '      retry: ImRecoveryService.instance.afterChatOpened,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 聊天页不再 create；统一转调 [WalletCardImSender]。\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _sendWalletCardWithStatus(\r\n'
            '    Map<String, dynamic> data, {\r\n'
            '    WalletCardSendSource source = WalletCardSendSource.payment,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    final mark = _walletCardMark(data);\r\n'
            '    if (mark.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      debugPrint(\'wallet-card skip empty-mark source=${source.name}\');\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final payloadConvId = data[\'conversationId\']?.toString().trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final convId =\r\n'
            '        payloadConvId.isNotEmpty ? payloadConvId : (_getConvID() ?? \'\');\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      debugPrint(\'wallet-card skip empty-target-conv source=${source.name}\');\r\n'
            '      WalletCardDispatchService.instance.enqueue(data);\r\n'
            '      WalletOrderEvents.notifyChatCardNeedSend(data);\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final orderId = data[\'orderId\']?.toString() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final clientOrderId = data[\'clientOrderId\']?.toString() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (await WalletCardReplayGuard.instance.alreadySent(\r\n'
            '      orderId: orderId,\r\n'
            '      clientOrderId: clientOrderId,\r\n'
            '    )) {\r\n'
            '      debugPrint(\'wallet-card skip already-sent clientOrderId=$clientOrderId\');\r\n'
            '      await _onWalletCardSentEvent(data);\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final sentMarks = _walletOutbound.sentMarksFor(convId);\r\n'
            '    if (sentMarks.contains(mark)) {\r\n'
            '      debugPrint(\'wallet-card skip sent-mark clientOrderId=$clientOrderId\');\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final ok = await WalletCardImSender.instance.send(data, source: source);\r\n'
            '    if (ok) {\r\n'
            '      sentMarks.add(mark);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  String _walletCardMark(Map<String, dynamic> data) {\r\n'
            '    final clientOrderId = data[\'clientOrderId\']?.toString() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final orderId = data[\'orderId\']?.toString() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final type = data[\'type\']?.toString() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final raw = \'${clientOrderId}_${orderId}_$type\';\r\n'
            '    return raw.replaceAll(RegExp(r\'_+$\'), \'\');\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  WalletCardSendSource _walletCardSendSourceOf(\r\n'
            '    Map<String, dynamic> data, {\r\n'
            '    required WalletCardSendSource fallback,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    switch (data[\'sendSource\']?.toString()) {\r\n'
            '      case \'payment\':\r\n'
            '        return WalletCardSendSource.payment;\r\n'
            '      case \'manual\':\r\n'
            '        return WalletCardSendSource.manual;\r\n'
            '      case \'recovery\':\r\n'
            '        return WalletCardSendSource.recovery;\r\n'
            '      case \'autoRetry\':\r\n'
            '        return WalletCardSendSource.autoRetry;\r\n'
            '      default:\r\n'
            '        return fallback;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'

            '        if (diceValue != null) {\r\n'
            '          final localId = message.id?.toString().trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '          final msgId = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '          // Widget key 必须优先钉死本地 id：发送成功补上 msgID 时不能拆掉 State，否则 webp 会被重建切掉。\r\n'
            '          Key? diceKey;\r\n'
            '          if (localId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '            diceKey = ValueKey<String>(\'dice_local_$localId\');\r\n'

            '            key: diceKey,\r\n'

            '        if (!StickerRepository.instance.isDynamicFaceData(data)) {\r\n'
            '          return null;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        return StickerFaceBubble(data: data);\r\n'

            '        onScrollToIndex,\r\n'
            '        isNeedShowJumpStatus,\r\n'
            '        clearJumpStatus,\r\n'
            '        onScrollToIndexBegin,\r\n'
            '      ) {\r\n'
            '        final uploadTaskId = attachmentUploadTaskId(\r\n'
            '            message, ApiClient.instance.authenticatedUserId);\r\n'
            '        if (uploadTaskId != null) {\r\n'
            '          return ChatAttachmentPendingMessage(\r\n'
            '            key: ValueKey(\'upload-card:$uploadTaskId\'),\r\n'
            '            taskId: uploadTaskId,\r\n'
            '            owner: ApiClient.instance.authenticatedUserId,\r\n'
            '            target: ChatAttachmentTarget.fromConversationId(_getConvID() ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '                isGroup: _getConvType() == ConvType.group),\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        // 通话中间态：气泡层会 shrink，但默认行仍带 bottom:20；整行直接收掉，避免大块空白。\r\n'
            '        if (CallingMessageDataProvider.looksLikeCallMessage(message) &&\r\n'
            '            !_shouldDisplayCallMessageInHistory(message)) {\r\n'
            '          return const SizedBox.shrink();\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (MessageUtils.isGroupCallingMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '          return messageWidget;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (MessageUtils.getCustomGroupCreatedOrDismissedString(\r\n'
            '          message,\r\n'
            '        ).isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '          return messageWidget;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (isGroupTipCustomMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '          return messageWidget;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (getFriendBecameFriendsDisplayText(\r\n'
            '          message.customElem,\r\n'
            '        ).isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '          return messageWidget;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (isC2cPeerRejectedTipMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '          return messageWidget;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (isRedPacketClaimNoticeMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '          return messageWidget;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        return null;\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '      customMessageItemBuilder: (message, isShowJump, clearJump) {\r\n'
            '        if (attachmentUploadTaskId(message,\r\n'
            '            ApiClient.instance.authenticatedUserId) != null) {\r\n'
            '          return const SizedBox.shrink();\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        final isWallet = CustomMessageElem.isWalletCardMessage(message);\r\n'
            '        final item = CustomMessageElem(\r\n'
            '          key: isWallet\r\n'
            '              ? ValueKey(CustomMessageElem.walletMessageWidgetKey(message))\r\n'
            '              : null,\r\n'
            '          message: message,\r\n'
            '          isShowJump: isShowJump,\r\n'
            '          clearJump: clearJump,\r\n'
            '          chatController: _chatController,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        if (!isWallet) {\r\n'
            '          return item;\r\n'

            '        // Never let a transient bad global scale become a sliver child extent.\r\n'
            '        // This boundary covers loading, success, and error wallet-card states.\r\n'
            '        // Use the item context so Chat.build does not subscribe to height.\r\n'
            '        return Builder(\r\n'
            '          builder: (itemContext) {\r\n'
            '            final viewportHeight = MediaQuery.heightOf(itemContext);\r\n'
            '            final maxWalletCardHeight =\r\n'

            '                child: item,\r\n'

            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'

            '      renderingDirectionCallback: (message) {\r\n'
            '        final isCallOutgoing = CustomMessageElem.isC2CCallOutgoing(message);\r\n'
            '        if (isCallOutgoing != null) {\r\n'
            '          V2TimUserFullInfo? userFullInfo;\r\n'
            '          if (isCallOutgoing) {\r\n'
            '            userFullInfo = TIMUIKitCore.getInstance().loginUserInfo;\r\n'
            '          } else {\r\n'
            '            final peerId = widget.selectedConversation.userID;\r\n'
            '            final peerFace = _c2cCallPeerFaceUrl(peerId);\r\n'
            '            userFullInfo = V2TimUserFullInfo(\r\n'
            '              userID: peerId,\r\n'
            '              faceUrl: peerFace,\r\n'
            '              nickName: widget.selectedConversation.showName,\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '          return RenderingDirectionResult(\r\n'
            '            isSelf: isCallOutgoing,\r\n'
            '            userInfo: userFullInfo,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        return null;\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// C2C 通话左侧头像：永远会话对端，不用 IM 发送者 faceUrl。\r\n'
            '  String _c2cCallPeerFaceUrl(String? peerUserId) {\r\n'
            '    final peerId = peerUserId?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (peerId.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        _resolvedPeerFaceUrlForId == peerId &&\r\n'
            '        (_resolvedPeerFaceUrl?.trim().isNotEmpty ?? false)) {\r\n'

            '    );\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  Widget _buildMessageAvatar(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    final avatarKey = ValueKey<String>(\r\n'
            '      \'msg_avatar_${message.msgID ?? message.id ?? message.timestamp}\',\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // C2C 通话：左右跟 provider.direction；左侧头像永远 peer，禁用 message.faceUrl。\r\n'
            '    final callOutgoing = CustomMessageElem.isC2CCallOutgoing(message);\r\n'
            '    if (callOutgoing == true) {\r\n'
            '      return AppUserAvatar(\r\n'
            '        key: avatarKey,\r\n'
            '        faceUrl: UserDisplayProfile.avatar(\r\n'
            '          userId:\r\n'
            '              serviceLocator<TUISelfInfoViewModel>().loginInfo?.userID ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '          fallbackIm: UserAvatarHelper.currentSelfFaceUrl(),\r\n'
            '          isSelf: true,\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '        showName: _messageDisplayName(message),\r\n'
            '        size: 40,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (callOutgoing == false) {\r\n'
            '      final peerUserId = widget.selectedConversation.userID;\r\n'
            '      return AppUserAvatar(\r\n'
            '        key: avatarKey,\r\n'
            '        faceUrl: _c2cCallPeerFaceUrl(peerUserId),\r\n'
            '        showName: _messageDisplayName(message),\r\n'
            '        size: 40,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() == ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      final sender = (message.sender ?? message.userID ?? \'\').trim();\r\n'
            '      final groupId = widget.selectedConversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      // 每个头像只监听 groupID + sender 对应的 revision；成员分页回填时，\r\n'
            '      // 仅真实变化的用户头像重建，不广播刷新群内全部可见头像。\r\n'
            '      return AnimatedBuilder(\r\n'
            '        key: avatarKey,\r\n'
            '        animation: GroupMemberStore.instance.avatarListenable(groupId, sender),\r\n'
            '        builder: (context, _) {\r\n'
            '          final storeMember = groupId.isNotEmpty && sender.isNotEmpty\r\n'
            '              ? GroupMemberStore.instance.memberOf(groupId, sender)\r\n'
            '              : null;\r\n'
            '          final member = sender.isNotEmpty\r\n'
            '              ? GroupAtMention.resolveMember(\r\n'
            '                  _chatController.getGroupMemberList(),\r\n'
            '                  sender,\r\n'
            '                )\r\n'
            '              : null;\r\n'
            '          final faceCandidate = <String?>[\r\n'
            '            storeMember?.faceUrl,\r\n'
            '            member?.faceUrl,\r\n'
            '            message.faceUrl,\r\n'
            '          ].firstWhere(\r\n'
            '            (e) => (e?.trim().isNotEmpty ?? false),\r\n'
            '            orElse: () => message.faceUrl,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '          final isSelf = message.isSelf == true;\r\n'
            '          final faceUrl = UserDisplayProfile.avatar(\r\n'
            '            userId: sender,\r\n'
            '            fallbackIm: faceCandidate,\r\n'
            '            isSelf: isSelf,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '          ChatJitterDiag.logAvatar(\r\n'
            '            sender: sender,\r\n'
            '            faceUrl: faceUrl,\r\n'
            '            source: \'buildMessageAvatar\',\r\n'
            '            cacheKey: \'$groupId|$sender\',\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '          return AppUserAvatar(\r\n'
            '            faceUrl: faceUrl,\r\n'
            '            showName: _messageDisplayName(message),\r\n'
            '            size: 40,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final peerUserId = widget.selectedConversation.userID;\r\n'
            '    final livePeerReady = _resolvedPeerFaceUrl?.trim().isNotEmpty == true &&\r\n'
            '        _resolvedPeerFaceUrlForId == peerUserId?.trim();\r\n'
            '    final localPeerFace = UserAvatarHelper.usableAvatarOrEmpty(\r\n'
            '      _peerLocalProfile?.avatarUrl,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final faceUrl =\r\n'
            '        PlatformOfficialAccountService.isPlatformOfficialAccount(peerUserId)\r\n'
            '            ? PlatformOfficialAccountService.resolveFaceUrl(\r\n'
            '                userId: peerUserId,\r\n'
            '                conversationFaceUrl: message.faceUrl,\r\n'
            '              )\r\n'
            '            : UserDisplayProfile.avatar(\r\n'
            '                userId: peerUserId ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '                fallbackIm: livePeerReady\r\n'
            '                    ? _resolvedPeerFaceUrl\r\n'
            '                    : (localPeerFace.isNotEmpty\r\n'
            '                        ? localPeerFace\r\n'
            '                        : message.faceUrl),\r\n'
            '              );\r\n'
            '    return AppUserAvatar(\r\n'
            '      key: avatarKey,\r\n'
            '      faceUrl: faceUrl,\r\n'
            '      showName: _messageDisplayName(message),\r\n'
            '      size: 40,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  String? _headerConversationFaceUrl() {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// 在关闭消息长按菜单后，把后续业务回调（收藏/表情/三公统计等）推到下一\r\n'
            '  /// 帧执行，避免与菜单 OverlayEntry.remove() + setState 在同一 microtask\r\n'
            '  /// 里抢主线程，导致菜单关闭后短暂卡顿、消息列表短暂无法滑动。\r\n'
            '  ///\r\n'
            '  /// 行为：\r\n'
            '  /// - 立刻同步调 [closeTooltip]，把 rootOverlay 上的 OverlayEntry 卸掉；\r\n'
            '  /// - 通过 [Future.microtask] 把 [task] 排到下一帧再跑。\r\n'
            '  /// - 业务侧的 async/await 在 microtask 队列里继续按原顺序执行（包括 toast\r\n'
            '  ///   / markRead 等副作用），只是不再和关闭菜单在同一帧同步展开。\r\n'
            '  void _runAfterTooltipClose(\r\n'

            '      try {\r\n'
            '        await task();\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {\r\n'
            '        // 业务回调内部已有 toast/错误处理；这里兜底吞异常，避免未来回执。\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// live-index 被 TCP / 列表侧 patch 后，同步当前群聊天顶栏（不等下次进页）。\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// T3: 群直播状态指纹——refresh 前后比较，不变时跳过 setState。\r\n'
