            '    _dismissChatInput();\r\n'
            '    // 有活跃场次即进入聊天顶栏直播画面（未推流也展示等待页）。\r\n'
            '    if (_watchingGroupLive) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final convId = _chatController.globalChatModel.currentSelectedConv.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _chatController.globalChatModel.beginGeometryViewportTransition(convId);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _retainedGroupLiveSessionId = session.liveSessionId;\n'
            '      _retainedGroupLiveChatGeneration = _chatOpenGeneration;\n'
            '      _watchingGroupLive = true;\n'
            '    });\n'
            '    _syncChatTopFixState();\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _scheduleEndGeometryViewportTransition(convId);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _closeGroupLiveWatch() {\r\n'
            '    if (!_watchingGroupLive) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final convId = _chatController.globalChatModel.currentSelectedConv.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _chatController.globalChatModel.beginGeometryViewportTransition(convId);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    setState(() => _watchingGroupLive = false);\r\n'
            '    _syncChatTopFixState();\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _scheduleEndGeometryViewportTransition(convId);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _handleGroupLiveIncomingMessage(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() != ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final payload = parseGroupLivePayload(message);\r\n'
            '    if (payload == null || !payload.isCard) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _groupLiveState.applyImPayload(payload);\r\n'
            '    unawaited(_loadGroupLiveCurrent());\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  ConvType _getConvType() {\r\n'
            '    final id = widget.selectedConversation.conversationID.trim().toLowerCase();\r\n'
            '    // 与腾讯云约定 / HistoryPeer 对齐：前缀硬覆盖误填 type。\r\n'
            '    if (id.startsWith(\'c2c_\')) {\r\n'
            '      return ConvType.c2c;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (id.startsWith(\'group_\')) {\r\n'
            '      return ConvType.group;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return widget.selectedConversation.type == 1\r\n'
            '        ? ConvType.c2c\r\n'
            '        : ConvType.group;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _prepareOfficialAccountChat() async {\n'
            '    final userId = widget.selectedConversation.userID?.trim() ?? \'\';\n'
            '    final isPlatformAccount =\n'
            '        PlatformOfficialAccountService.isPlatformOfficialAccount(userId);\n'
            '    if (!isPlatformAccount &&\n'
            '        !PlatformOfficialAccountService.isVerifiedBadgeAccount(userId)) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (!mounted) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final resolvedFace = PlatformOfficialAccountService.resolveFaceUrl(\r\n'
            '      userId: widget.selectedConversation.userID,\r\n'
            '      conversationFaceUrl: _conversation.faceUrl,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (resolvedFace.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _conversation.faceUrl = resolvedFace;\r\n'
            '      _cachedHeaderFaceUrl = resolvedFace;\n'
            '      _syncChatHeaderState();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (isPlatformAccount) {\n'
            '      final openedConversationId = _resolvedConversationID();\n'
            '      // The standard C2C local snapshot and cloud verification own history.\n'
            '      // Account profile/settings work must not start at tap time or make a\n'
            '      // second local + cloud history request compete with the first window.\n'
            '      unawaited(() async {\n'
            '        try {\n'
            '          await PlatformOfficialAccountService.ensureReadyForChat(\n'
            '            userId: userId,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        } catch (error) {\n'
            '          debugPrint(\'Official account preparation failed: $error\');\n'
            '          return;\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        if (!mounted || !_isCurrentConversation(openedConversationId)) {\n'
            '          return;\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        final refreshedFace = PlatformOfficialAccountService.resolveFaceUrl(\n'
            '          userId: userId,\n'
            '          conversationFaceUrl: _conversation.faceUrl,\n'
            '        );\n'
            '        if (refreshedFace.isNotEmpty) {\n'
            '          _conversation.faceUrl = refreshedFace;\n'
            '          _cachedHeaderFaceUrl = refreshedFace;\n'
            '          _syncChatHeaderState();\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        final conversationKey = _getConvID()?.trim() ?? \'\';\n'
            '        final messages = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>()\n'
            '            .messageListMap[conversationKey];\n'
            '        if (messages != null && messages.isNotEmpty) {\n'
            '          _normalizeOfficialAccountMessageAvatars(userId, messages);\n'
            '          _normalizeSelfMessageAvatars(messages);\n'
            '          setState(() {});\n'
            '        }\n'
            '      }());\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    await _hydrateOfficialAccountMessageList();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _hydrateOfficialAccountMessageList() async {\r\n'
            '    final userId = widget.selectedConversation.userID;\r\n'
            '    if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // TIMUIKitChat indexes C2C history by the canonical conversation key\r\n'
            '    // (`c2c_<userId>`), not by the bare peer userId. Writing the hydrated\r\n'
            '    // official-account messages under the bare id leaves the visible chat\r\n'
            '    // window with an empty message list.\r\n'
            '    final conversationKey = _getConvID()?.trim().isNotEmpty == true\r\n'
            '        ? _getConvID()!.trim()\r\n'
            '        : \'c2c_${ChatIdFormat.canonicalC2cUserId(userId)}\';\r\n'
            '    if (conversationKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    var messages =\r\n'
            '        await PlatformOfficialAccountService.fetchChatHistoryMessages(\r\n'
            '      userId: userId,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final last = widget.selectedConversation.lastMessage;\r\n'
            '    if (messages.isEmpty && last != null) {\r\n'
            '      messages = [last];\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (messages.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '    final existing = globalModel.messageListMap[conversationKey];\r\n'
            '    if (existing != null && existing.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _normalizeOfficialAccountMessageAvatars(userId, existing);\r\n'
            '      _normalizeSelfMessageAvatars(existing);\r\n'
            '      globalModel.commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '        MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '          conversationKey: conversationKey,\r\n'
            '          eventID:\r\n'
            '              \'official_account_hydrate_existing:${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}\',\r\n'
            '          kind: MessageDeltaKind.optimisticAdoption,\r\n'
            '          source: MessageDeltaSource.historyEnvelope,\r\n'
            '          generation: globalModel.messageDeltaGenerationFor(userId),\r\n'
            '          clearEpoch: globalModel.messageDeltaClearEpochFor(userId),\r\n'
            '          replace: true,\r\n'
            '          upserts: existing.map(globalModel.messageDeltaRecord),\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _normalizeOfficialAccountMessageAvatars(userId, messages);\r\n'
            '    _normalizeSelfMessageAvatars(messages);\r\n'
            '    globalModel.commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '      MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '        conversationKey: conversationKey,\r\n'
            '        eventID:\r\n'
            '            \'official_account_hydrate:${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}\',\r\n'
            '        kind: MessageDeltaKind.optimisticAdoption,\r\n'
            '        source: MessageDeltaSource.historyEnvelope,\r\n'
            '        generation: globalModel.messageDeltaGenerationFor(userId),\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch: globalModel.messageDeltaClearEpochFor(userId),\r\n'
            '        replace: true,\r\n'
            '        upserts: messages.map(globalModel.messageDeltaRecord),\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    globalModel.setMessageListPosition(userId, HistoryMessagePosition.bottom);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _normalizeSelfMessageAvatars(List<V2TimMessage> messages) {\r\n'
            '    final resolvedFace = UserAvatarHelper.currentSelfFaceUrl();\r\n'
            '    if (resolvedFace.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    var changed = false;\r\n'
            '    for (final message in messages) {\r\n'
            '      if (message.isSelf != true) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if ((message.faceUrl ?? \'\').trim() == resolvedFace) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      message.faceUrl = resolvedFace;\r\n'
            '      changed = true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return changed;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _seedCachedHistoryOnOpen(String convKey) {\r\n'
            '    if (convKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '    globalModel.setMessageListPosition(\r\n'
            '      convKey,\r\n'
            '      HistoryMessagePosition.bottom,\r\n'
            '      notify: false,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final rawCount = globalModel.rawMessageCount(convKey);\r\n'
            '    if (rawCount > 0) {\r\n'
            '      final list = globalModel.getMessageList(convKey);\r\n'
            '      if (list != null) {\r\n'
            '        _normalizeSelfMessageAvatars(list);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (globalModel.hasInitialHistoryLoaded(convKey)) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (rawCount >= HistoryMessageDartConstant.initialOpenFetchCount) {\r\n'
            '        globalModel.markInitialHistoryLoaded(convKey);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _isOpenHistoryWarm(String convKey) {\r\n'
            '    if (convKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '    if (!globalModel.hasInitialHistoryLoaded(convKey)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // removeMessageList 会删掉 map 条目；若只剩残留 loaded 别名，不能当暖窗，\r\n'
            '    // 否则跳过 gate 又无消息 → 整页空灰。\r\n'
            '    final raw = globalModel.rawMessageList(convKey);\r\n'
            '    if (raw == null) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (raw.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 空 list：仅在「会话确实像空」且没有并行 peek 时算 warm。\r\n'
            '    // 冷开并行期间禁止把空占位当成暖窗，否则会跳过 gate + hydrate_keep_empty。\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.hasOpenHydrateInFlight(convKey)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _conversationLooksEmptyForOpen(convKey);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 列表侧已无真实历史证据时，进页应直接空态，而不是先转圈拉历史。\r\n'
            '  bool _conversationLooksEmptyForOpen(String convKey) {\r\n'
            '    if (convKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.rawMessageCount(convKey) > 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final conv = widget.selectedConversation;\r\n'
            '    if ((conv.unreadCount ?? 0) > 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final last = conv.lastMessage;\r\n'
            '    // 仅 lastMessage 缺失才预判空。最新一条是 tip/灰字不代表 SDK 无历史；\r\n'
            '    // 冷开并行 peek 前误标 empty-loaded 会 hydrate_keep_empty → 灰屏。\r\n'
            '    //\r\n'
            '    // 社群：列表预览因 ID/落库失败暂时为 null 时，禁止预判空——否则再进页\r\n'
            '    // 会 clearLocalHistoryAsEmptyLoaded，跳过云端拉历史，聊天记录整页空白。\r\n'
            '    if (last == null && _getConvType() == ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return last == null;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _ensureEmptyConversationReadyForOpen(String convKey) {\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '    // 冷开并行 peek 未完成：禁止预判 empty-loaded。\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.hasOpenHydrateInFlight(convKey)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_conversationLooksEmptyForOpen(convKey)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.hasInitialHistoryLoaded(convKey) &&\r\n'
            '        globalModel.rawMessageCount(convKey) == 0) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    globalModel.clearLocalHistoryAsEmptyLoaded(convKey);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _startOpenHistoryGate(String convKey) {\r\n'
            '    _openLifecycle.openHistoryGateConvKey = convKey;\r\n'
            '    _openLifecycle.openHistoryPreparationGate = null;\r\n'
            '    if (convKey.isEmpty ||\r\n'
            '        widget.initFindingMsg != null ||\r\n'
            '        widget.searchJumpAnchor != null ||\r\n'
            '        UnreadTonguePolicy.isEntryUnreadEnabledForConvType(\r\n'
            '          _getConvType(),\r\n'
            '          widget.entryUnreadCount ?? 0,\r\n'
            '        )) {\r\n'
            '      _openLifecycle.openHistoryGate = null;\r\n'
            '      if (convKey.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        ChatHistoryOpenLayoutReady.cancel(convKey);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 先同步灌入缓存；只有完整首屏（或确认空）才跳过 gate。\r\n'
            '    // 列表 LOCAL 预热常常只有几条：立刻上屏会在反转列表底部露出大片空白。\r\n'
            '    _seedCachedHistoryOnOpen(convKey);\r\n'
            '    _ensureEmptyConversationReadyForOpen(convKey);\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '    final rawCount = globalModel.rawMessageCount(convKey);\r\n'
            '    final emptyConfirmed =\r\n'
            '        globalModel.hasInitialHistoryLoaded(convKey) && rawCount == 0;\r\n'
            '    final completeWindow =\r\n'
            '        ConversationPreviewHistorySync.isCompleteOpenHistoryWindow(\r\n'
            '      globalModel: globalModel,\r\n'
            '      conversationKey: convKey,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // 完整首屏或确认空：无需等待可交互 gate。\r\n'
            '    if (completeWindow || emptyConfirmed) {\r\n'
            '      ChatHistoryOpenLayoutReady.cancel(convKey);\r\n'
            '      ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '        \'history_gate_content_ready_skip\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: convKey,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'rawCount\': rawCount,\r\n'
            '          \'emptyConfirmed\': emptyConfirmed,\r\n'
            '          \'completeWindow\': completeWindow,\r\n'
            '          \'initialLoaded\': globalModel.hasInitialHistoryLoaded(convKey),\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _openLifecycle.openHistoryGate = null;\r\n'
            '      final preparation = _prepareOpenHistoryGate(\r\n'
            '        convKey,\r\n'
            '        cachedHistorySeeded: true,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _openLifecycle.openHistoryPreparationGate = preparation;\r\n'
            '      unawaited(preparation);\r\n'
            '      if (_getConvType() == ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '        unawaited(_ensureGroupLocalTipsMergedOnOpen(convKey));\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    ChatHistoryOpenLayoutReady.begin(convKey);\r\n'
            '    // 未灌满的预热窗也走 prepare + layout，避免先亮底部几条。\r\n'
            '    // 真冷零消息仍串行；事件名保留 cold_shell，兼容既有性能日志。\r\n'
            '    final thinWindow = rawCount > 0;\r\n'
            '    ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '      thinWindow ? \'history_gate_thin_window\' : \'history_gate_cold_shell\',\r\n'
            '      conversationID: convKey,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\'rawCount\': rawCount},\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final preparation = _prepareOpenHistoryGate(\r\n'
            '      convKey,\r\n'
            '      cachedHistorySeeded: true,\r\n'
            '      coldOpen: !thinWindow,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _openLifecycle.openHistoryPreparationGate = preparation;\r\n'
            '    _openLifecycle.openHistoryGate = _runOpenHistoryGateWithTipsMerge(\r\n'
            '      convKey,\r\n'
            '      coldOpen: !thinWindow,\r\n'
            '      preparation: preparation,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 先权威历史（冷开 / 薄窗均可 soft-timeout），再合本地 tip，\r\n'
            '  /// 再等几何 ready。preparation 绝不能无限挂起，否则 AbsorbPointer 锁死滚动。\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _runOpenHistoryGateWithTipsMerge(\r\n'
            '    String convKey, {\r\n'
            '    required bool coldOpen,\r\n'
            '    required Future<void> preparation,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    if (convKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 薄窗与真冷共用硬超时：薄窗原先无超时，云端慢时门永不关 → 能返回不能滑。\r\n'
            '    await preparation.timeout(\r\n'
            '      const Duration(milliseconds: 1200),\r\n'
            '      onTimeout: () {\r\n'
            '        ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '          coldOpen\r\n'
            '              ? \'history_gate_timeout_1_2s\'\r\n'
            '              : \'history_gate_thin_timeout_1_2s\',\r\n'
            '          conversationID: convKey,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      await _ensureGroupLocalTipsMergedOnOpen(\r\n'
            '        convKey,\r\n'
            '      ).timeout(const Duration(milliseconds: 400));\r\n'
            '    } on TimeoutException {\r\n'
            '      ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '        \'history_gate_tips_merge_timeout\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: convKey,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    } catch (_) {\r\n'
            '      // tip 合并失败不挡揭开门。\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 列表已经揭开并 signal 过：不要二次 begin 抬 epoch，否则会把已亮的历史闪没。\r\n'
            '    if (ChatHistoryOpenLayoutReady.isReady(convKey)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 作废 prepare/tip 期间可能发出的假 signal，再等几何 ready。\r\n'
            '    ChatHistoryOpenLayoutReady.begin(convKey);\r\n'
            '    await _waitOpenHistoryLayoutReady(convKey);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _waitOpenHistoryLayoutReady(String convKey) async {\r\n'
            '    // History preparation already has a 1.2s soft timeout. Do not add another\r\n'
            '    // full second of shell time when hidden-list geometry cannot settle yet.\r\n'
            '    final ready = await ChatHistoryOpenLayoutReady.wait(\r\n'
            '      convKey,\r\n'
            '      timeout: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (!ready) {\r\n'
            '      ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '        \'history_open_ready_timeout\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: convKey,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _prepareOpenHistoryGate(\r\n'
            '    String convKey, {\r\n'
            '    bool cachedHistorySeeded = false,\r\n'
            '    bool coldOpen = false,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    if (convKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!cachedHistorySeeded) {\r\n'
            '      _seedCachedHistoryOnOpen(convKey);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '    ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '      \'prepare_gate_start\',\r\n'
            '      conversationID: convKey,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\'coldOpen\': coldOpen},\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // Reuse the local-only snapshot started at tap time. Direct entry paths\r\n'
            '    // that do not pass through the conversation list start the same bounded\r\n'
            '    // local task here. Cloud verification remains outside this gate.\r\n'
            '    final loaded =\r\n'
            '        await ChatOpenViewportCoordinator.instance.ensureLocalSnapshotForOpen(\r\n'
            '      conversation: _conversation,\r\n'
            '      timeout: const Duration(milliseconds: 900),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\r\n'
            '    if (loaded) {\r\n'

            '  Future<void> _runOpenHistoryEnrichment(\r\n'
            '    String convKey, {\r\n'
            '    required bool Function() canRun,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    if (!canRun()) return;\r\n'
            '    final chatModel = _chatController.model;\r\n'
            '    if (chatModel != null) {\r\n'
            '      await chatModel.runPostOpenProfileEnrichment();\r\n'
            '      if (!canRun()) return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final pendingMedia = _pendingOpenHistoryMediaEnrichment;\r\n'
            '    _pendingOpenHistoryMediaEnrichment = null;\r\n'
            '    if (pendingMedia != null && pendingMedia.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      await MessageMediaMetadataStore.instance.hydrateMessages(pendingMedia);\r\n'
            '      if (!canRun()) return;\r\n'
            '      final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '      if (_getConvType() == ConvType.c2c) {\r\n'
            '        ChatImageMessagePrefetch.prefetchThumbnailsForFirstWindow(pendingMedia);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      for (final message in pendingMedia) {\r\n'
            '        globalModel.mergeMessageMediaMetadata(message);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      unawaited(\r\n'
            '        MessageMediaMetadataStore.instance.persistFromMessages(pendingMedia),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      StickerMessagePrefetch.fromMessages(pendingMedia);\r\n'
            '      ChatImageMessagePrefetch.fromHistoricalBatch(pendingMedia);\r\n'
            '      unawaited(\r\n'
            '        ChatImageMessagePrefetch.resolveOnlineUrlsForMessages(\r\n'
            '          pendingMedia,\r\n'
            '          onMessageResolved: globalModel.mergeMessageMediaMetadata,\r\n'
            '        ).then((_) {\r\n'
            '          if (!canRun()) return;\r\n'
            '          unawaited(\r\n'
            '            MessageMediaMetadataStore.instance.persistFromMessages(\r\n'
            '              pendingMedia,\r\n'
            '            ),\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '          ChatImageMessagePrefetch.fromHistoricalBatch(pendingMedia);\r\n'
            '        }).catchError((_) {}),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final seedSw = Stopwatch()..start();\r\n'
            '    await _seedSelfMemberFromLocalStore();\r\n'
            '    if (!canRun()) return;\r\n'
            '    ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '      \'prepare_gate_self_member_seeded\',\r\n'
            '      conversationID: convKey,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'selfMemberMs\': seedSw.elapsedMilliseconds,\r\n'
            '        \'isGroup\': _getConvType() == ConvType.group,\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final messages = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>().getMessageList(\r\n'
            '      convKey,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (messages != null && messages.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '      ChatMainThreadPerf.measure(\r\n'
            '        ChatMainThreadPerf.imageDecodeMs,\r\n'
            '        () => ChatImageMessagePrefetch.fromMessages(messages),\r\n'
            '        count: messages.length,\r\n'
            '        source: \'open_enrichment_prefetch\',\r\n'
            '        conversationType: _getConvType().name,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      await ChatImageMessagePrefetch.resolveOnlineUrlsForMessages(messages);\r\n'
            '      for (final message in messages) {\r\n'
            '        globalModel.mergeMessageMediaMetadata(message);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (!canRun()) return;\r\n'
            '      ChatImageMessagePrefetch.fromMessages(messages);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() == ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      await _hydrateGroupMessageAvatarsFromLocal();\r\n'
            '      if (!canRun()) return;\r\n'
            '      ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '        \'group_avatar_hydrate_done\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: convKey,\r\n'

            '    }\r\n'
            '    await _warmAvatarsOnChatOpen();\r\n'
            '    if (!canRun()) return;\r\n'
            '    ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\'avatar_warm_done\', conversationID: convKey);\r\n'
            '    await _runPostOpenHistorySideEffects(convKey);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _seedSelfMemberFromLocalStore() async {\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() != ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupId = ChatIdFormat.normalizeGroupId(\r\n'
            '      widget.selectedConversation.groupID,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final selfId = ContactSocialCacheStore.safeLoginUserId().trim();\r\n'
            '    if (groupId.isEmpty || selfId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final localGroup = await GroupLocalStore.instance.read(groupId: groupId);\r\n'
            '    final members = await GroupMemberLocalStore.instance.readByUserIds(\r\n'
            '      groupId: groupId,\r\n'
            '      userIds: <String>[selfId],\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    V2TimGroupMemberFullInfo? localSelf =\r\n'
            '        members.isEmpty ? null : members.first;\r\n'
            '    final existing = GroupMemberStore.instance.memberOf(groupId, selfId);\r\n'
            '    final nowSec = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch ~/ 1000;\r\n'
            '    final localMute = localSelf?.muteUntil ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    final existingMute = existing?.muteUntil ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    final isAllMuted = localGroup?.isAllMuted == true;\r\n'
            '    final role = localGroup?.myRole ??\r\n'
            '        localSelf?.role ??\r\n'
            '        existing?.role ??\r\n'
            '        GroupMemberRoleType.V2TIM_GROUP_MEMBER_ROLE_MEMBER;\r\n'
            '    final exempt = GroupRolePolicy.isMuteExemptRole(role);\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    int effectiveMute = existingMute > localMute ? existingMute : localMute;\r\n'
            '    if (isAllMuted && !exempt) {\r\n'
            '      // JS-safe permanent mute sentinel (Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER).\r\n'
            '      effectiveMute = 0x1FFFFFFFFFFFFF;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (localSelf == null &&\r\n'
            '        existing == null &&\r\n'
            '        localGroup == null &&\r\n'
            '        effectiveMute <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final seeded = V2TimGroupMemberFullInfo(\r\n'
            '      userID: selfId,\r\n'
            '      role: role,\r\n'
            '      nickName: localSelf?.nickName ?? existing?.nickName,\r\n'
            '      nameCard: localSelf?.nameCard ?? existing?.nameCard,\r\n'
            '      friendRemark: localSelf?.friendRemark ?? existing?.friendRemark,\r\n'
            '      faceUrl: localSelf?.faceUrl ?? existing?.faceUrl,\r\n'
            '      joinTime: localSelf?.joinTime ?? existing?.joinTime,\r\n'
            '      muteUntil: effectiveMute > 0 ? effectiveMute : null,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    GroupMemberStore.instance.putMember(groupId, seeded, notify: false);\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    Future<void> applyToModel() async {\r\n'
            '      final model = _chatController.model;\r\n'
            '      if (model == null || !mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (isAllMuted || effectiveMute > nowSec) {\r\n'
            '        await model.updateSelfMuteStatus(\r\n'
            '          groupID: groupId,\r\n'
            '          muteUntil:\r\n'
            '              isAllMuted ? 0 : (effectiveMute > nowSec ? effectiveMute : 0),\r\n'
            '          isAllMuted: isAllMuted,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      model.updateSelfMemberInfo(seeded, groupID: groupId);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    await applyToModel();\r\n'
            '    if (_chatController.model == null && mounted) {\r\n'
            '      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 80));\r\n'
            '      await applyToModel();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _hydrateGroupMessageAvatarsFromLocal() async {\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() != ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupId = widget.selectedConversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final convKey = _getConvID()?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (groupId.isEmpty || convKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '    final messages = globalModel.messageListMap[convKey];\r\n'
            '    if (messages == null || messages.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final senderIds = <String>{};\r\n'
            '    for (final message in messages.take(50)) {\r\n'
            '      if (message.isSelf == true) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final sender = (message.sender ?? message.userID ?? \'\').trim();\r\n'
            '      if (sender.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        senderIds.add(sender);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (senderIds.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final members = await GroupMemberLocalStore.instance.readByUserIds(\r\n'
            '        groupId: groupId, userIds: senderIds.toList(growable: false));\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || members.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logGroupMemberStore(\r\n'
            '      action: \'hydrateGroupMessageAvatarsFromLocal\',\r\n'
            '      groupId: groupId,\r\n'
            '      memberCount: members.length,\r\n'
            '      notify: false,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // 仅在既有成员 faceUrl 真正变化时通知头像刷新，避免首次灌入/昵称变化误触发闪动。\r\n'
            '    final faceUrlChangedUserIDs = <String>{};\r\n'
            '    for (final member in members) {\r\n'
            '      final userID = member.userID.trim();\r\n'
            '      if (userID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final prev = GroupMemberStore.instance.memberOf(groupId, userID);\r\n'
            '      if (prev == null) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final prevUrl = prev.faceUrl?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      final nextUrl = member.faceUrl?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (prevUrl != nextUrl) {\r\n'
            '        faceUrlChangedUserIDs.add(userID);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    GroupMemberStore.instance.putMembers(groupId, members, notify: false);\r\n'
            '    if (faceUrlChangedUserIDs.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.logGroupMemberStore(\r\n'
            '        action: \'hydrateGroupMessageAvatarsFromLocal_skip_notify\',\r\n'
            '        groupId: groupId,\r\n'
            '        memberCount: members.length,\r\n'
            '        notify: false,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 转场结束后再通知；再延后一帧，避开 post_open 同帧 setState 叠加重绘。\r\n'
            '    _scheduleAfterRouteTransition(() {\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '        if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '          return;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        ChatJitterDiag.logGroupMemberStore(\r\n'
            '          action: \'hydrateGroupMessageAvatarsFromLocal_notify\',\r\n'
            '          groupId: groupId,\r\n'
            '          memberCount: members.length,\r\n'
            '          notify: true,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        GroupMemberStore.instance.notifyChatAvatarRefreshForUsers(\r\n'
            '          groupId,\r\n'
            '          faceUrlChangedUserIDs,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      });\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 等当前路由 push 转场 [AnimationStatus.completed] 后再执行，避免进场中途刷 UI。\r\n'
            '  void _scheduleAfterRouteTransition(VoidCallback task) {\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final animation = ModalRoute.of(context)?.animation;\r\n'
            '      if (animation != null && !animation.isCompleted) {\r\n'
            '        void listener(AnimationStatus status) {\r\n'
            '          if (status != AnimationStatus.completed &&\r\n'
            '              status != AnimationStatus.dismissed) {\r\n'
            '            return;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          _removeRouteTransitionListener(animation, listener);\r\n'
            '          if (status != AnimationStatus.completed) {\r\n'
            '            return;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '            return;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          ChatJitterDiag.log(\r\n'
            '            \'after_route_transition\',\r\n'
            '            extras: const <String, Object?>{\'source\': \'animation_completed\'},\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '          task();\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '        _addRouteTransitionListener(animation, listener);\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.log(\r\n'
            '        \'after_route_transition\',\r\n'
            '        extras: const <String, Object?>{\'source\': \'already_completed\'},\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      task();\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'

            '  void _normalizeOfficialAccountMessageAvatars(\r\n'
            '    String userId,\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> messages,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (!PlatformOfficialAccountService.showsVerifiedBadge(userId)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final resolvedFace = PlatformOfficialAccountService.resolveFaceUrl(\r\n'
            '      userId: userId,\r\n'
            '      conversationFaceUrl:\r\n'
            '          _conversation.faceUrl ?? widget.selectedConversation.faceUrl,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (resolvedFace.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final message in messages) {\r\n'
            '      if (message.isSelf == true) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if ((message.faceUrl ?? \'\').trim() == resolvedFace) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      message.faceUrl = resolvedFace;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 其他设备退群后，本端 IM 会话可能残留；进入时校验群成员资格并剔除幽灵会话。\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _verifyGroupMembershipOnOpen() async {\r\n'
            '    final identity = SessionIdentityService.instance.capture();\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() != ConvType.group ||\r\n'
            '        !SelfHostedGroupBridge.governanceEnabled) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupId = _getConvID()?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (groupId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      final detail =\r\n'
            '          await GroupMembershipSyncService.instance.fetchJoinedGroupFromImSdk(\r\n'
            '        groupId,\r\n'
            '        throwIfDenied: true,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted || !SessionIdentityService.instance.isCurrent(identity))\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      if (detail != null) {\r\n'
            '        await GroupLocalStore.instance\r\n'
            '            .upsert(ownerUserId: identity.ownerUserId, record: detail);\r\n'
            '        await _seedSelfMemberFromLocalStore();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    } catch (error) {\r\n'
            '      // Offline/timeouts are not proof of removal. Only an authoritative\r\n'
            '      // membership denial may evict the conversation.\r\n'
            '      if (!GroupMemberIncrementalSyncService.isMembershipDenied(error)) return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || !SessionIdentityService.instance.isCurrent(identity))\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    await GroupMembershipSyncService.instance.onSelfRemovedFromGroup(groupId);\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\r\n'
            '    final navigator = Navigator.of(context);\r\n'
            '    if (navigator.canPop()) {\r\n'
            '      navigator.pop();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  String _headerAvatarUrlHash(String? value) {\r\n'
            '    final normalized = value?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (normalized.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'empty\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return normalized.hashCode.toUnsigned(32).toRadixString(16).padLeft(8, \'0\');\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _logGroupHeaderAvatarSource({\r\n'
            '    required String source,\r\n'
            '    required String currentFaceUrl,\r\n'
            '    required String candidateFaceUrl,\r\n'
            '    required bool applied,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    // 头像源追溯默认关闭。\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _onGroupCacheHydrated() {\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || _getConvType() != ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (GroupLocalStore.instance.cacheHydration.value.ownerUserId !=\r\n'
            '        GroupLocalStore.instance.currentOwnerUserId()) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupId = widget.selectedConversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (groupId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    unawaited(_applyCurrentGroupStoreCommit(groupId));\r\n'
            '    unawaited(_refreshGroupSnapshotCount());\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _onGroupStoreCommit() {\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || _getConvType() != ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupId = widget.selectedConversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (groupId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final commit = GroupLocalStore.instance.commitListenable.value;\r\n'
            '    final containsCurrentGroup = commit.upserted.any(\r\n'
            '      (record) => ChatIdFormat.groupIdsEquivalent(record.groupId, groupId),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (commit.kind != GroupStoreMutationKind.reset &&\r\n'
            '        commit.upserted.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        !containsCurrentGroup) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    unawaited(_applyCurrentGroupStoreCommit(groupId));\r\n'
            '    unawaited(_refreshGroupSnapshotCount());\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _onGroupMemberStoreCommit() {\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || _getConvType() != ConvType.group) return;\r\n'
            '    final commit = GroupMemberLocalStore.instance.commitListenable.value;\r\n'
            '    final owner = GroupMemberLocalStore.instance.currentOwnerUserId();\r\n'
            '    if (commit.ownerUserId.isNotEmpty && commit.ownerUserId != owner) return;\r\n'
            '    if (commit.groupId.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        !ChatIdFormat.groupIdsEquivalent(\r\n'
            '            commit.groupId, widget.selectedConversation.groupID)) return;\r\n'
            '    unawaited(_refreshGroupSnapshotCount());\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Header count is Store.memberCount (SDK-written). Do not pin to SQL COUNT.\r\n'
            '  /// Coalesce commits while the local read is running; a newer commit must\r\n'
            '  /// still be observed before this task finishes.\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _refreshGroupSnapshotCount() {\r\n'
            '    _groupSnapshotCountDirty = true;\r\n'
            '    final pending = _groupSnapshotCountTask;\r\n'
            '    if (pending != null) return pending;\r\n'
            '    late final Future<void> task;\r\n'
            '    task = (() async {\r\n'
            '      do {\r\n'
            '        _groupSnapshotCountDirty = false;\r\n'
            '        if (!mounted || _getConvType() != ConvType.group) return;\r\n'
            '        final groupId = widget.selectedConversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '        final generation = _groupMemberCountGeneration;\r\n'
            '        if (groupId.isEmpty) return;\r\n'
            '        final raw =\r\n'
            '            GroupLocalStore.instance.readCached(groupId: groupId)?.memberCount;\r\n'
            '        final next = (raw != null && raw > 0) ? raw : null;\r\n'
            '        if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '            generation != _groupMemberCountGeneration ||\r\n'
            '            !ChatIdFormat.groupIdsEquivalent(\r\n'
            '                groupId, widget.selectedConversation.groupID)) continue;\r\n'
            '        if (next != null) {\r\n'
            '          if (_groupMemberCount != next) {\r\n'
            '            _groupMemberCount = next;\r\n'
            '            _syncChatHeaderState();\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        } else if (_groupMemberCount != null && _groupMemberCount! <= 0) {\r\n'
            '          _groupMemberCount = null;\r\n'
            '          _syncChatHeaderState();\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } while (_groupSnapshotCountDirty);\r\n'
            '    })()\r\n'
            '        .catchError((Object _) {\r\n'
            '      // An unavailable local database does not invalidate an already shown\r\n'
            '      // count. A subsequent commit or page entry retries the local read.\r\n'
            '    }).whenComplete(() {\r\n'
            '      if (identical(_groupSnapshotCountTask, task))\r\n'
            '        _groupSnapshotCountTask = null;\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    _groupSnapshotCountTask = task;\r\n'
            '    return task;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _applyCurrentGroupStoreCommit(String groupId) async {\r\n'
            '    var record = GroupLocalStore.instance.readCached(groupId: groupId);\r\n'
            '    if (record == null) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final checkedNotice = record.notice.trim();\r\n'
            '    var notice = checkedNotice;\r\n'
            '    if (notice.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        await GroupNoticeMarqueeDismissService.instance.isDismissed(\r\n'
            '          groupId: groupId,\r\n'
            '          notice: notice,\r\n'
            '        )) {\r\n'
            '      notice = \'\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '        !ChatIdFormat.groupIdsEquivalent(\r\n'
            '          widget.selectedConversation.groupID,\r\n'
            '          groupId,\r\n'
            '        )) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Re-read after the async dismissal check. If another group metadata\r\n'
            '    // commit landed meanwhile, publish the latest Store-owned record/version.\r\n'
            '    record = GroupLocalStore.instance.readCached(groupId: groupId);\r\n'
            '    if (record == null) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (record.notice.trim() != checkedNotice) {\r\n'
            '      unawaited(_applyCurrentGroupStoreCommit(groupId));\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _applyGroupMetadataSnapshot(\r\n'
            '      GroupMetadataSnapshot(\r\n'
            '        groupId: record.groupId,\r\n'
            '        name: record.groupName.trim(),\r\n'
            '        memberCount: record.memberCount > 0 ? record.memberCount : null,\r\n'
            '        notice: notice,\r\n'
            '        avatarUrl: record.avatarUrl.trim(),\r\n'
            '        source: GroupMetadataSource.storeCommit,\r\n'
            '        generation: GroupLocalStore.instance.listDataRevision,\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '      localPlaceholder: false,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 进入群聊首帧：同步灌入本地群资料缓存，避免标题和头像二次变化。\r\n'
            '  void _seedGroupDisplayFromMemory() {\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() != ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupId = widget.selectedConversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (groupId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupList = serviceLocator<TUIFriendShipViewModel>().groupList;\r\n'
            '    // 首帧只接受本地群资料库中的已提交人数。SDK groupList 可能是旧快照，\r\n'
            '    // 不能先写入头部再等待 REST/本地库把它纠正，否则会产生可见跳变。\r\n'
            '    final cachedRecord = GroupLocalStore.instance.readCached(groupId: groupId);\r\n'
            '    final cachedCount = cachedRecord?.memberCount ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    if (cachedRecord != null && cachedCount > 0) {\r\n'
            '      _groupMemberCount = cachedCount;\r\n'
            '      _groupMemberCountPinnedToLocalSnapshot = false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 公告必须由异步加载路径检查关闭记录后发布。首帧直接显示缓存正文\r\n'
            '    // 会让已关闭的公告先出现，再被 _hydrateGroupDisplayFromLocal 隐藏。\r\n'
            '    final cachedAvatar = GroupLocalStore.instance\r\n'
            '            .readCached(groupId: groupId)\r\n'
            '            ?.avatarUrl\r\n'
            '            .trim() ??\r\n'
            '        \'\';\r\n'
            '    final hasCachedAvatar = cachedAvatar.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        !UserAvatarHelper.isDefaultPlaceholder(cachedAvatar);\r\n'
            '    final currentFace = (_conversation.faceUrl ?? \'\').trim();\r\n'
            '    // 展示信群资料库：本地可用且不同时优先群库，避免开场旧头像锁死。\r\n'
            '    final faceUrl = hasCachedAvatar\r\n'
            '        ? cachedAvatar\r\n'
            '        : GroupDisplayResolver.resolveFaceUrl(\r\n'
            '            conversation: _conversation,\r\n'
            '            groupList: groupList,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '    final shouldApply = faceUrl.isNotEmpty && faceUrl != currentFace;\r\n'
            '    _logGroupHeaderAvatarSource(\r\n'
            '      source: hasCachedAvatar ? \'memory_local_cache\' : \'memory_conversation\',\r\n'
            '      currentFaceUrl: currentFace,\r\n'
            '      candidateFaceUrl: faceUrl,\r\n'
            '      applied: shouldApply,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (shouldApply) {\r\n'
            '      _conversation.faceUrl = faceUrl;\r\n'
            '      widget.selectedConversation.faceUrl = faceUrl;\r\n'
            '      _cachedHeaderFaceUrl = faceUrl;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 进入群聊后立即读本地 SQLite，补齐人数/公告/头像；后台网络刷新仅在值变化时更新 UI。\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _hydrateGroupDisplayFromLocal() async {\r\n'
            '    await _refreshGroupSnapshotCount();\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() != ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupId = widget.selectedConversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (groupId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    var snapshot = await GroupMetadataRefreshCoordinator.instance\r\n'
            '        .readLocalPlaceholder(groupId);\r\n'
            '    if (snapshot == null) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (snapshot.notice.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        await GroupNoticeMarqueeDismissService.instance.isDismissed(\r\n'
            '          groupId: groupId,\r\n'
            '          notice: snapshot.notice,\r\n'
            '        )) {\r\n'
            '      snapshot = GroupMetadataSnapshot(\r\n'
            '        groupId: snapshot.groupId,\r\n'
            '        name: snapshot.name,\r\n'
            '        memberCount: snapshot.memberCount,\r\n'
            '        notice: \'\',\r\n'
            '        avatarUrl: snapshot.avatarUrl,\r\n'
            '        source: snapshot.source,\r\n'
            '        generation: snapshot.generation,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _applyGroupMetadataSnapshot(snapshot, localPlaceholder: true);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _applyGroupMetadataSnapshot(\r\n'
            '    GroupMetadataSnapshot snapshot, {\r\n'
            '    required bool localPlaceholder,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '        _getConvType() != ConvType.group ||\r\n'
            '        !ChatIdFormat.groupIdsEquivalent(\r\n'
            '          widget.selectedConversation.groupID,\r\n'
            '          snapshot.groupId,\r\n'
            '        )) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final prevCount = _groupMemberCount;\r\n'
            '    final prevNotice = _groupSide.groupNoticeBanner;\r\n'
            '    final prevFace = _conversation.faceUrl ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final prevShowName = _conversation.showName ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    ChatMainThreadPerf.measure(\r\n'
            '      ChatMainThreadPerf.groupMetadataApplyMs,\r\n'
            '      () {\r\n'
            '        if (snapshot.memberCount != null &&\r\n'
            '            !_groupMemberCountPinnedToLocalSnapshot) {\r\n'
            '          _groupMemberCount = snapshot.memberCount;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (snapshot.name.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '            !GroupDisplayResolver.looksLikeGroupIdLabel(\r\n'
            '              snapshot.name,\r\n'
            '              groupId: snapshot.groupId,\r\n'
            '            )) {\r\n'
            '          _conversation.showName = snapshot.name;\r\n'
            '          widget.selectedConversation.showName = snapshot.name;\r\n'
            '          conversationName = snapshot.name;\r\n'
            '          _cachedHeaderShowName = snapshot.name;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (snapshot.avatarUrl.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '            !UserAvatarHelper.isDefaultPlaceholder(snapshot.avatarUrl) &&\r\n'
            '            (!localPlaceholder || (_conversation.faceUrl ?? \'\').isEmpty)) {\r\n'
            '          _conversation.faceUrl = snapshot.avatarUrl;\r\n'
            '          widget.selectedConversation.faceUrl = snapshot.avatarUrl;\r\n'
            '          _cachedHeaderFaceUrl = snapshot.avatarUrl;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (!localPlaceholder || _groupSide.groupNoticeBanner.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '          _groupSide.groupNoticeBanner = snapshot.notice;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        final headerChanged = _groupMemberCount != prevCount ||\r\n'
            '            (_conversation.faceUrl ?? \'\') != prevFace ||\r\n'
            '            (_conversation.showName ?? \'\') != prevShowName;\r\n'
            '        final noticeChanged = _groupSide.groupNoticeBanner != prevNotice;\r\n'
            '        if (headerChanged) {\r\n'
            '          _syncChatHeaderState();\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (noticeChanged) {\r\n'
            '          _syncChatTopFixState();\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '      count: 1,\r\n'
            '      source: snapshot.source.name,\r\n'
            '      conversationType: \'group\',\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _isCurrentConversation(String conversationId) {\r\n'
            '    return mounted &&\r\n'
            '        MessageConversationId.sameConversation(\r\n'
            '          _resolvedConversationID(),\r\n'
            '          conversationId,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _applyResolvedGroupNoticeBanner({\r\n'
            '    required String groupId,\r\n'
            '    required String notice,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    var body = notice.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (body.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        await GroupNoticeMarqueeDismissService.instance.isDismissed(\r\n'
            '          groupId: groupId,\r\n'
            '          notice: body,\r\n'
            '        )) {\r\n'
            '      body = \'\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_isCurrentConversation(groupId) ||\r\n'
            '        body == _groupSide.groupNoticeBanner) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _groupSide.groupNoticeBanner = body;\r\n'
            '    _syncChatTopFixState();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _loadGroupMemberCount({bool force = false}) async {\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() != ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      if (_groupMemberCount != null && mounted) {\r\n'
            '        _groupMemberCount = null;\r\n'
            '        _syncChatHeaderState();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupID = widget.selectedConversation.groupID ?? "";\r\n'
            '    if (groupID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final conversationId = _resolvedConversationID();\r\n'
            '    final generation = _groupMemberCountGeneration;\r\n'
            '    await _refreshGroupSnapshotCount();\r\n'
            '    if (!_isCurrentConversation(conversationId) ||\r\n'
            '        generation != _groupMemberCountGeneration) return;\r\n'
            '    // 进群聊只读本地快照，不再 REST 拉群详情。\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _loadGroupGameStatus() {\r\n'
            '    final inFlight = _openGroupGameEnrichmentInFlight;\r\n'
            '    if (inFlight != null) {\r\n'
            '      return inFlight;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final task = _loadGroupGameStatusImpl();\r\n'
            '    _openGroupGameEnrichmentInFlight = task;\r\n'
            '    return task.whenComplete(() {\r\n'
            '      if (identical(_openGroupGameEnrichmentInFlight, task)) {\r\n'
            '        _openGroupGameEnrichmentInFlight = null;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _loadGroupGameStatusImpl() async {\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() != ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      if (_groupSide.groupFeatureEnabled ||\r\n'
            '          _groupSide.groupGameEnabled ||\r\n'
            '          _groupSide.sangongConfigured ||\r\n'
            '          _groupSide.sangongNeedsSetup ||\r\n'
            '          !_groupSide.groupGameFloatVisible) {\r\n'
            '        if (mounted) {\r\n'
            '          setState(() {\r\n'
            '            _groupSide.groupFeatureEnabled = false;\r\n'
            '            _groupSide.groupGameEnabled = false;\r\n'
            '            _groupSide.groupGameFloatVisible = true;\r\n'
            '            _groupSide.clearSangongAccess();\r\n'
            '          });\r\n'
            '          _syncChatTopFixState();\r\n'
            '          _invalidateChatConfigCache();\r\n'
            '          _updateSangongRealtimeSubscription();\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupId = _getConvID()?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (groupId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final conversationId = _resolvedConversationID();\r\n'
            '    final tenantGroupId = ChatIdFormat.normalizeGroupId(groupId);\r\n'
            '    unawaited(SangongGameHttp.hydrateTenant());\r\n'
            '    await SangongMyConfigService.instance.ensureHydrated();\r\n'
            '    if (!_isCurrentConversation(conversationId)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final cachedGroupEnabled =\r\n'
            '        GroupLocalStore.instance.readCached(groupId: groupId)?.gameEnabled ??\r\n'
            '            false;\r\n'
            '    final cachedUserEnabled = PrivilegedGameUserService.instance.isPrivileged;\r\n'
            '    // 先用本地 my-config 秒开入口，避免等网络闪一下。\r\n'
            '    final cachedSangongAccess = SangongMyConfigService.resolveGroupAccess(\r\n'
            '      config: SangongMyConfigService.instance.hasCachedConfig\r\n'
            '          ? SangongMyConfigService.instance.config\r\n'
            '          : null,\r\n'
            '      groupId: tenantGroupId,\r\n'
            '      userPrivileged: cachedUserEnabled,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (cachedSangongAccess.tenantId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      SangongGameHttp.setTenantId(cachedSangongAccess.tenantId);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (mounted) {\r\n'
            '      final changed = cachedGroupEnabled != _groupSide.groupFeatureEnabled ||\r\n'
            '          cachedUserEnabled != _groupSide.groupGameEnabled ||\r\n'
            '          !_sangongAccessMatches(_groupSide, cachedSangongAccess);\r\n'

            '          _groupSide.groupFeatureEnabled = cachedGroupEnabled;\r\n'
            '          _groupSide.groupGameEnabled = cachedUserEnabled;\r\n'
            '          _applySangongAccessToSide(cachedSangongAccess);\r\n'

            '      // 返回旧结果，也不能再次把刚保存的三公状态覆盖掉。\r\n'
            '      final myConfig = SangongMyConfigService.instance.configListenable.value ??\r\n'

            '        config: myConfig,\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '      final sideChanged = groupEnabled != _groupSide.groupFeatureEnabled ||\r\n'
            '          userEnabled != _groupSide.groupGameEnabled ||\r\n'
            '          floatVisible != _groupSide.groupGameFloatVisible ||\r\n'

            '          // MeGroup.gameEnabled 仍给代理反水等群特性用。\r\n'

            '          _groupSide.groupGameEnabled = userEnabled;\r\n'
            '          _applySangongAccessToSide(sangongAccess);\r\n'

            '        _updateSangongRealtimeSubscription();\r\n'

            '  Future<void> _loadAgentRebateIdentity() async {\r\n'

            '          _groupSide.agentRebateGroupBound = cached.bound;\r\n'

            '\r\n'

            '  /// 外部报表/管理接口等待期间显示转圈；[action] 返回后自动关闭。\r\n'
            '  Future<T?> _runSangongRemoteAction<T>({\r\n'

            '  void _scheduleGroupNoticeRecheck({\r\n'
            '    Duration delay = const Duration(milliseconds: 350),\r\n'
            '    bool forceRetry = false,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() != ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    Future<void>.delayed(delay, () {\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (!_canShowGroupNoticePopup()) {\r\n'
            '        _groupSide.pendingGroupNoticeRecheck = true;\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (forceRetry || _groupSide.pendingGroupNoticeRecheck) {\r\n'
            '        _groupSide.pendingGroupNoticeRecheck = false;\r\n'
            '        unawaited(_recheckGroupNoticeUntilShown());\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      unawaited(_checkAndShowGroupNoticeIfNeeded());\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _recheckGroupNoticeUntilShown({\r\n'
            '    int maxAttempts = 8,\r\n'
            '    Duration firstDelay = const Duration(milliseconds: 220),\r\n'
            '    Duration retryDelay = const Duration(milliseconds: 450),\r\n'
            '    String? forcedNoticeText,\r\n'
            '    int? pushTs,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() != ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (var attempt = 0; attempt < maxAttempts; attempt++) {\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (attempt > 0) {\r\n'
            '        await Future<void>.delayed(retryDelay);\r\n'
            '      } else if (firstDelay > Duration.zero) {\r\n'
            '        await Future<void>.delayed(firstDelay);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted || !_canShowGroupNoticePopup()) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (!_isForegroundGroupChat()) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final shown = await _checkAndShowGroupNoticeIfNeeded(\r\n'
            '        forcedNoticeText: forcedNoticeText,\r\n'
            '        pushTs: pushTs,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (shown) {\r\n'
            '        _groupSide.pendingGroupNoticeRecheck = false;\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'

            '    _openGroupNoticeAfterTransitionInFlight = task;\r\n'
