            '  Future<void> _waitForCurrentRouteTransition() async {\r\n'
            '    final firstFrame = Completer<void>();\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '      if (!firstFrame.isCompleted) {\r\n'
            '        firstFrame.complete();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    await firstFrame.future;\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final animation = ModalRoute.of(context)?.animation;\r\n'
            '    if (animation == null || animation.isCompleted || animation.isDismissed) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final done = Completer<void>();\r\n'
            '    void listener(AnimationStatus status) {\r\n'
            '      if (status != AnimationStatus.completed &&\r\n'
            '          status != AnimationStatus.dismissed) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _removeRouteTransitionListener(animation, listener);\r\n'
            '      if (!done.isCompleted) {\r\n'
            '        done.complete();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    _addRouteTransitionListener(animation, listener);\r\n'
            '    await done.future;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _presentOpenGroupNoticeAfterTransition({\r\n'
            '    required int generation,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    if (_groupSide.checkingGroupNotice) {\r\n'
            '      _groupSide.pendingGroupNoticeRecheck = true;\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _groupSide.checkingGroupNotice = true;\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      final resolvedFuture = _resolveGroupNoticePopup();\r\n'
            '      await _waitForCurrentRouteTransition();\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted || generation != _chatOpenPhaseGeneration) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final resolved = await resolvedFuture ??\r\n'
            '          await _resolveGroupNoticePopup();\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '          generation != _chatOpenPhaseGeneration ||\r\n'
            '          resolved == null) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (GroupNoticeRefreshBus.instance.isSideProfilePanelOpen) {\r\n'
            '        _groupSide.pendingGroupNoticeRecheck = true;\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      await _presentResolvedGroupNotice(resolved);\r\n'
            '    } finally {\r\n'
            '      _groupSide.checkingGroupNotice = false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<({String groupId, String notice, String signature, int? lastInfoTime})?>\r\n'
            '      _resolveGroupNoticePopup({\r\n'
            '    String? forcedNoticeText,\r\n'
            '    int? pushTs,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() != ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupId = widget.selectedConversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (groupId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    var record = GroupLocalStore.instance.readCached(groupId: groupId);\r\n'
            '    record ??= await GroupInfoResolver.instance.readGroup(groupId);\r\n'
            '    final forced = forcedNoticeText?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final notice = (forced.isNotEmpty\r\n'
            '        ? forced\r\n'
            '        : (record?.notice.trim().isNotEmpty == true\r\n'
            '            ? record!.notice.trim()\r\n'
            '            : _groupSide.groupNoticeBanner.trim()));\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || notice.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final owner = (record?.ownerUserId ?? \'\').trim();\r\n'
            '    final lastInfoTime = (record?.noticeUpdatedAt ?? 0) > 0\r\n'
            '        ? (record!.noticeUpdatedAt ~/ 1000)\r\n'
            '        : 0;\r\n'
            '    final signature = pushTs != null\r\n'
            '        ? _groupNoticePushSignature(\r\n'
            '            groupId: groupId,\r\n'
            '            notice: notice,\r\n'
            '            pushTs: pushTs,\r\n'
            '          )\r\n'
            '        : _groupNoticeSignature(\r\n'
            '            groupId: groupId,\r\n'
            '            notice: notice,\r\n'
            '            owner: owner,\r\n'
            '            lastInfoTime: lastInfoTime,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '    final acked = await GroupNoticeAckService.instance.getAckSignature(\r\n'
            '      groupId,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '        GroupNoticeAckService.isAcknowledged(\r\n'
            '          ackedSignature: acked,\r\n'
            '          currentSignature: signature,\r\n'
            '          groupId: groupId,\r\n'
            '          notice: notice,\r\n'
            '        )) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return (\r\n'
            '      groupId: groupId,\r\n'
            '      notice: notice,\r\n'
            '      signature: signature,\r\n'
            '      lastInfoTime: lastInfoTime > 0 ? lastInfoTime : null,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _presentResolvedGroupNotice(\r\n'
            '    ({String groupId, String notice, String signature, int? lastInfoTime})\r\n'
            '        resolved,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    return _presentGroupNoticeOverlay(\r\n'
            '      notice: resolved.notice,\r\n'
            '      lastInfoTime: resolved.lastInfoTime,\r\n'
            '      barrierDismissible: false,\r\n'
            '      enableDrag: false,\r\n'
            '      onGotIt: (_) async {\r\n'
            '        await GroupNoticeAckService.instance.saveAckSignature(\r\n'
            '          resolved.groupId,\r\n'
            '          resolved.signature,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _isForegroundGroupChat() {\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() != ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupId = widget.selectedConversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (groupId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final active = ExternalChatEntryService.instance;\r\n'
            '    final resolvedId = _resolvedConversationID();\r\n'
            '    if (resolvedId.isNotEmpty && active.isVisibleChat(resolvedId)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (active.isVisibleChat(\'group_$groupId\')) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (active.isVisibleChat(groupId)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_canShowGroupNoticePopup()) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final route = ModalRoute.of(context);\r\n'
            '    return route == null || route.isCurrent;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _handleIncomingGroupNoticePush({\r\n'
            '    String? forcedNoticeText,\r\n'
            '    int? pushTs,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    if (!_isForegroundGroupChat()) {\r\n'
            '      _groupSide.pendingGroupNoticeRecheck = true;\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final shown = await _checkAndShowGroupNoticeIfNeeded(\r\n'
            '      forcedNoticeText: forcedNoticeText,\r\n'
            '      pushTs: pushTs,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (shown) {\r\n'
            '      _groupSide.pendingGroupNoticeRecheck = false;\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    await _recheckGroupNoticeUntilShown(\r\n'
            '      maxAttempts: 8,\r\n'
            '      firstDelay: Duration.zero,\r\n'
            '      retryDelay: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),\r\n'
            '      forcedNoticeText: forcedNoticeText,\r\n'
            '      pushTs: pushTs,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _onGroupNoticeRefreshRequested() {\r\n'
            '    final event = GroupNoticeRefreshBus.instance.lastRefresh.value;\r\n'
            '    if (event == null) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupId = widget.selectedConversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (groupId.isEmpty || event.groupId != groupId) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    unawaited(_loadGroupNoticeBanner(forcedText: event.notification));\r\n'
            '    if (GroupNoticeRefreshBus.instance.shouldSuppressPopup(groupId) ||\r\n'
            '        GroupNoticeRefreshBus.instance.shouldSuppressPopup(event.groupId)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isForegroundGroupChat()) {\r\n'
            '      unawaited(\r\n'
            '        _handleIncomingGroupNoticePush(\r\n'
            '          forcedNoticeText: event.notification,\r\n'
            '          pushTs: event.pushTs,\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _scheduleGroupNoticeRecheck(forceRetry: true);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _onGroupRealtimeChanged() {\r\n'
            '    final notice = GroupSyncService.instance.lastChanged.value;\r\n'
            '    if (notice == null) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupId = widget.selectedConversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (groupId.isEmpty ||\r\n'
            '        !ChatIdFormat.groupIdsEquivalent(notice.groupId, groupId)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (GroupSyncService.memberCountRefreshActions.contains(notice.action)) {\r\n'
            '      // GroupSyncService 已在发布事件前触发群详情刷新；头部只消费\r\n'
            '      // GroupLocalStore.commitListenable，避免同一成员变更重复请求详情。\r\n'
            '      _clearMountedDisplayListCache();\r\n'
            '      unawaited(_applyGroupTipsOperatorPatches());\r\n'
            '      if (!_hasVisibleHistoryMessages()) {\r\n'
            '        unawaited(_reloadChatHistoryIfEmpty(reason: \'group_realtime\'));\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (notice.action == \'group_live_changed\') {\r\n'
            '      final detail = notice.detail;\r\n'
            '      if (detail != null && detail.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        _groupLiveState.applyTcpDetail(\r\n'
            '          Map<String, dynamic>.from(detail),\r\n'
            '          groupId: groupId,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        final session = _groupLiveState.activeSession;\r\n'
            '        if (session == null || !session.status.isActiveSlot) {\r\n'
            '          _watchingGroupLive = false;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // TCP 详情可能缺 liveSessionId / 字段不全：始终用 REST current 校对，\r\n'
            '      // 否则主播开推后顶栏会一直停在「有直播」直到杀进程重进。\r\n'
            '      unawaited(_loadGroupLiveCurrent());\r\n'
            '      _syncChatTopFixState();\r\n'
            '      setState(() {});\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (notice.action == \'group_mute_all_changed\' ||\r\n'
            '        notice.action == \'member_muted\') {\r\n'
            '      unawaited(_refreshChatGroupMuteState());\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (notice.action != \'group_notice_changed\') {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    unawaited(_loadGroupNoticeBanner(forcedText: notice.notification));\r\n'
            '    if (GroupNoticeRefreshBus.instance.shouldSuppressPopup(groupId) ||\r\n'
            '        GroupNoticeRefreshBus.instance.shouldSuppressPopup(notice.groupId)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    unawaited(\r\n'
            '      _handleIncomingGroupNoticePush(\r\n'
            '        forcedNoticeText: notice.notification,\r\n'
            '        pushTs: notice.pushTs,\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<bool> _checkAndShowGroupNoticeIfNeeded({\r\n'
            '    String? forcedNoticeText,\r\n'
            '    int? pushTs,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    if (_groupSide.checkingGroupNotice || _getConvType() != ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      if (_groupSide.checkingGroupNotice) {\r\n'
            '        _groupSide.pendingGroupNoticeRecheck = true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_canShowGroupNoticePopup()) {\r\n'
            '      _groupSide.pendingGroupNoticeRecheck = true;\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _groupSide.pendingGroupNoticeRecheck = false;\r\n'
            '    _groupSide.checkingGroupNotice = true;\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      final resolved = await _resolveGroupNoticePopup(\r\n'
            '        forcedNoticeText: forcedNoticeText,\r\n'
            '        pushTs: pushTs,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted || resolved == null) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      await _presentResolvedGroupNotice(resolved);\r\n'
            '      return mounted;\r\n'
            '    } finally {\r\n'
            '      _groupSide.checkingGroupNotice = false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  String _formatGroupNoticeTime(int? timestamp) {\r\n'
            '    if (timestamp == null || timestamp <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return \'\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final ms = timestamp >= 1000000000000 ? timestamp : timestamp * 1000;\r\n'
            '    final date = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(ms);\r\n'
            '    final locale = AppI18n.current.locale.languageTag;\r\n'
            '    final lang = locale.startsWith(\'zh\')\r\n'
            '        ? \'zh_CN\'\r\n'
            '        : locale == \'ja\'\r\n'
            '            ? \'ja\'\r\n'
            '            : locale == \'ko\'\r\n'
            '                ? \'ko\'\r\n'
            '                : \'en\';\r\n'
            '    final pattern = locale.startsWith(\'en\')\r\n'
            '        ? \'MMM d, yyyy HH:mm\'\r\n'
            '        : locale == \'ja\'\r\n'
            '            ? \'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm\'\r\n'
            '            : locale == \'ko\'\r\n'
            '                ? \'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm\'\r\n'
            '                : \'yyyy年MM月dd日 HH:mm\';\r\n'
            '    return DateFormat(pattern, lang).format(date);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'

            '      // 认证号不可进入聊天设置（含 99Messenger / 支付助手等）。\r\n'
            '      if (PlatformOfficialAccountService.showsVerifiedBadge(userID)) {\r\n'
            '        if (PlatformOfficialAccountService.isPlatformOfficialAccount(userID)) {\r\n'
            '          final intro =\r\n'
            '              PlatformOfficialAccountService.introductionFor(userID) ??\r\n'
            '                  PlatformOfficialAccountService.resolveShowName(\r\n'
            '                    userId: userID,\r\n'
            '                    conversationShowName: _getTitle(),\r\n'
            '                  );\r\n'

            '            return;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          AppDialog.alert(\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// 从盖在 Chat 上的二级页返回后，恢复 registry、解除可能卡住的 open gate，\r\n'
            '  /// 列表空则重拉历史；有消息时强制贴底并刷新，避免 Opacity/滚动态导致整页空白。\r\n'

            '    _overlayReturnRecoveryInFlight = task;\n'
            '    _overlayReturnRecoveryConversationId = conversationID;\n'
            '    return task.whenComplete(() {\n'
            '      if (identical(_overlayReturnRecoveryInFlight, task)) {\n'

            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _performChatHistoryAfterOverlayReturn({\n'

            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'

            '        \'convKey\': convKey,\r\n'
            '        \'type\': _getConvType().name,\r\n'
            '        \'hasPreviewLastMessage\': preview != null,\r\n'
            '        \'previewMsgId\': previewMsgId,\r\n'
            '        \'entryUnread\': widget.entryUnreadCount ?? 0,\r\n'
            '        \'cachedRaw\': serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>().rawMessageCount(\r\n'
            '          convKey,\r\n'

            '            .hasInitialHistoryLoaded(convKey),\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      if (model == null) {\r\n'
            '        ChatDiagLog.log(\r\n'
            '          \'ChatHistory\',\r\n'
            '          \'reload_if_empty_no_model\',\r\n'

            '        \'hasMessages\': _hasVisibleHistoryMessages(),\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void _syncConversationMetaFromViewModel() {\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\r\n'
            '    final conversationID = _conversation.conversationID;\r\n'
            '    var changed = false;\r\n'

            '    final groupId = _conversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final localRecord = isGroup && groupId.isNotEmpty\r\n'

            '    final hasLocalFace = localFace.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        !UserAvatarHelper.isDefaultPlaceholder(localFace);\r\n'
            '    final hasLocalName = localName.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        !GroupDisplayResolver.looksLikeGroupIdLabel(\r\n'
            '          localName,\r\n'
            '          groupId: groupId,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '    final peerId = isC2c ? (_conversation.userID?.trim() ?? \'\') : \'\';\r\n'
            '    final peerLocal = isC2c && peerId.isNotEmpty\r\n'
            '        ? (_peerLocalProfile ??\r\n'
            '            UserProfileLocalService.instance.readCached(peerId))\r\n'
            '        : null;\r\n'
            '    final localPeerFace = UserAvatarHelper.usableAvatarOrEmpty(\r\n'
            '      peerLocal?.avatarUrl,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final localPeerName = !isC2c\r\n'
            '        ? \'\'\r\n'
            '        : FriendDisplayName.resolveLocalFirst(\r\n'
            '            localProfile: peerLocal,\r\n'
            '            userId: peerId,\r\n'
            '            conversationShowName: _conversation.showName,\r\n'
            '            friendList: serviceLocator<TUIFriendShipViewModel>().friendList,\r\n'
            '          ).trim();\r\n'
            '    if (conversationID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      for (final conv in _conversationViewModel.conversationList) {\r\n'
            '        if (conv?.conversationID == conversationID) {\r\n'
            '          final latestUrl = conv?.faceUrl ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '          if (latestUrl.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '              latestUrl != (_conversation.faceUrl ?? \'\')) {\r\n'
            '            final shouldApplyFace = isGroup\r\n'
            '                ? (!hasLocalFace || latestUrl == localFace)\r\n'
            '                : (!isC2c ||\r\n'
            '                    localPeerFace.isEmpty ||\r\n'
            '                    latestUrl == localPeerFace);\r\n'
            '            if (shouldApplyFace) {\r\n'
            '              if (isGroup) {\r\n'
            '                _logGroupHeaderAvatarSource(\r\n'
            '                  source: \'conversation_model_update\',\r\n'
            '                  currentFaceUrl: _conversation.faceUrl ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '                  candidateFaceUrl: latestUrl,\r\n'
            '                  applied: true,\r\n'

            '              }\r\n'
            '              _conversation.faceUrl = latestUrl;\r\n'
            '              widget.selectedConversation.faceUrl = latestUrl;\r\n'
            '              changed = true;\r\n'
            '            } else if (isGroup) {\r\n'
            '              // Local avatar wins; skip path must not mark changed / rebuild.\r\n'
            '              // Profile-only log — no further work.\r\n'
            '              if (kProfileMode) {\r\n'
            '                _logGroupHeaderAvatarSource(\r\n'
            '                  source: \'conversation_model_update_skipped_local_newer\',\r\n'
            '                  currentFaceUrl: _conversation.faceUrl ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '                  candidateFaceUrl: latestUrl,\r\n'
            '                  applied: false,\r\n'
            '                );\r\n'
            '              }\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          final latestShowName = conv?.showName?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '          if (latestShowName.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '              latestShowName != (_conversation.showName?.trim() ?? \'\')) {\r\n'
            '            final shouldApplyName = isGroup\r\n'
            '                ? (!hasLocalName || latestShowName == localName)\r\n'
            '                : (!isC2c ||\r\n'
            '                    localPeerName.isEmpty ||\r\n'
            '                    latestShowName == localPeerName);\r\n'
            '            if (shouldApplyName) {\r\n'
            '              _conversation.showName = latestShowName;\r\n'

            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (isGroup && hasLocalFace) {\r\n'

            '      if (localFace != currentFace) {\r\n'

            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (isC2c && localPeerName.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final currentName = (_conversation.showName ?? \'\').trim();\r\n'
            '      if (localPeerName != currentName) {\r\n'
            '        _conversation.showName = localPeerName;\r\n'
            '        widget.selectedConversation.showName = localPeerName;\r\n'
            '        changed = true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (PlatformOfficialAccountService.isPlatformOfficialAccount(\r\n'
            '      _conversation.userID,\r\n'
            '    )) {\r\n'
            '      final resolved = PlatformOfficialAccountService.resolveFaceUrl(\r\n'
            '        userId: _conversation.userID,\r\n'
            '        conversationFaceUrl: _conversation.faceUrl,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (resolved.isNotEmpty && resolved != (_conversation.faceUrl ?? \'\')) {\r\n'
            '        _conversation.faceUrl = resolved;\r\n'
            '        widget.selectedConversation.faceUrl = resolved;\r\n'
            '        changed = true;\r\n'

            '    final showName = _conversation.showName ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (!changed &&\r\n'
            '        faceUrl == (_cachedHeaderFaceUrl ?? \'\') &&\r\n'
            '        showName == (_cachedHeaderShowName ?? \'\')) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _cachedHeaderFaceUrl = faceUrl;\r\n'
            '    _cachedHeaderShowName = showName;\r\n'
            '    _syncChatHeaderState();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _onConversationViewModelChanged() {\r\n'
            '    _syncConversationMetaFromViewModel();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _onTapAvatar(\r\n'
            '    String userID,\r\n'
            '    TapDownDetails tapDetails,\r\n'
            '    TUITheme theme,\r\n'
            '  ) async {\r\n'
            '    final id = userID.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (id.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _dismissChatInput();\r\n'
            '    if (ProfilePageNav.isSelfUser(id)) {\r\n'
            '      await ProfilePageNav.openMyProfileDetail(context);\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _refreshSelfMessageAvatars();\r\n'
            '      await _recoverChatHistoryAfterOverlayReturn(\r\n'
            '        reason: \'return_from_my_profile\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'

            '        }\r\n'

            '              : AppI18n.of(context).t(\r\n'
            '                  zhHans: \'平台官方通知账号\',\r\n'
            '                  zhHant: \'平台官方通知帳號\',\r\n'
            '                  en: \'Official platform notice account\',\r\n'
            '                  ja: \'公式プラットフォーム通知アカウント\',\r\n'
            '                  ko: \'플랫폼 공식 알림 계정\',\r\n'
            '                ),\r\n'
            '          buttonText: AppI18n.of(\r\n'
            '            context,\r\n'
            '          ).t(zhHans: \'知道了\', zhHant: \'知道了\', en: \'Got it\', ja: \'了解\', ko: \'확인\'),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'

            '      return;\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '    GroupAtMentionTarget? groupMember;\r\n'

            '        _chatController.getGroupMemberList(),\r\n'
            '        id,\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'

            '    final hud = AppHud.begin();\r\n'
            '    final bool friendDeleted;\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      friendDeleted = await ProfilePageNav.openUserProfileOrAddFriend(\r\n'
            '        context,\r\n'
            '        userID: id,\r\n'
            '        nickname: groupMember?.displayName,\r\n'
            '        avatarUrl: groupMember?.faceUrl,\r\n'
            '        addSource: _getConvType() == ConvType.group\r\n'
            '            ? FriendAddSource.card\r\n'
            '            : FriendAddSource.chat,\r\n'
            '        groupId: _getConvType() == ConvType.group\r\n'
            '            ? widget.selectedConversation.groupID\r\n'
            '            : null,\r\n'
            '        onRemarkUpdate: (String newRemark) {\r\n'
            '          _applyConversationRemarkUpdate(newRemark);\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    } finally {\r\n'
            '      await hud.end();\r\n'

            '    if (friendDeleted && mounted && _getConvType() == ConvType.c2c) {\r\n'
            '      Navigator.of(context).maybePop();\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_getConvType() == ConvType.c2c) {\r\n'
            '      unawaited(_loadPeerFaceUrl());\r\n'
            '      unawaited(_loadPeerLocalProfile());\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    await _loadChatBackground();\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    await _recoverChatHistoryAfterOverlayReturn(\r\n'
            '      reason: \'return_from_avatar_profile\',\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// 仅写入 [TIMUIKitChatBackgroundRegistry]；勿因背景加载而 setState 更换 TIMUIKitChat 的 Key。\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _loadChatBackground() async {\r\n'
            '    final conversationId = _resolvedConversationID();\r\n'
            '    if (conversationId.isEmpty ||\r\n'
            '        PlatformOfficialAccountService.isPlatformOfficialAccount(\r\n'
            '          widget.selectedConversation.userID,\r\n'
            '        ) ||\r\n'
            '        ChatBackgroundService.isOfficialAccountConversationId(conversationId)) {\r\n'
            '      if (conversationId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        TIMUIKitChatBackgroundRegistry.clearPath(conversationId);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    await ChatBackgroundService.instance.getBackgroundPathWithGlobalFallback(\r\n'
            '      conversationId,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _completeChatOpenInitStage(\r\n'
            '    _ChatOpenInitStage stage, {\r\n'
            '    int count = 0,\r\n'
            '    String source = \'chat\',\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (!_chatOpenCompletedStages.add(stage)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final elapsedMs = _chatOpenInitStopwatch.elapsedMilliseconds;\r\n'
            '    final event = switch (stage) {\r\n'
            '      _ChatOpenInitStage.sdkReady => \'chat_open_sdk_ready_ms\',\r\n'
            '      _ChatOpenInitStage.historyReady => \'chat_open_history_ready_ms\',\r\n'
            '      _ChatOpenInitStage.localMetadataReady => \'chat_open_metadata_ms\',\r\n'
            '      _ChatOpenInitStage.backgroundEnrichment =>\r\n'
            '        \'chat_open_background_enrichment_ms\',\r\n'
            '    };\r\n'
            '    ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '      event,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'durationMs\': elapsedMs,\r\n'
            '        \'count\': count,\r\n'
            '        \'source\': source,\r\n'
            '        \'stage\': stage.name,\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _markChatOpenHistoryReady() {\r\n'
            '    if (!_openLifecycle.markHistoryReady(_chatOpenPhaseGeneration)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '      \'chat_open_phase_history_ready_ms\',\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'durationMs\': _chatOpenInitStopwatch.elapsedMilliseconds,\r\n'
            '        \'count\': 1,\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final generation = _chatOpenPhaseGeneration;\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted || generation != _chatOpenPhaseGeneration) return;\r\n'
            '      if (_openLifecycle.markInteractive(generation)) {\r\n'
            '        ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '          \'chat_open_phase_interactive_ms\',\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'durationMs\': _chatOpenInitStopwatch.elapsedMilliseconds,\r\n'
            '            \'count\': 1,\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        _tryMarkChatOpenEnriched();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    _scheduleDeferredHistoryVerification(generation);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 首帧前只展示本地 SDK 快照。首帧稳定后由统一 Coordinator 负责云端\r\n'
            '  /// 校验、重试和 gap repair；这里不再根据会话预览决定是否同步。\r\n'
            '  void _scheduleDeferredHistoryVerification(int generation) {\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '          generation != _chatOpenPhaseGeneration ||\r\n'
            '          !_isCurrentConversation(_resolvedConversationID())) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // DIAG: 首帧稳定后 dump 当前会话元信息 + IM06 scope 状态。\r\n'
            '      // 目的：让日志能精准关联到用户看到的会话（如"无边心是岸"）。\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        final convID = _getConvID()?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '        final convType = _getConvType();\r\n'
            '        final peerID = convType == ConvType.group\r\n'
            '            ? (_conversation.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\')\r\n'
            '            : (_conversation.userID?.trim() ?? \'\');\r\n'
            '        final displayName = _conversation.showName?.trim() ??\r\n'
            '            widget.selectedConversation.showName?.trim() ??\r\n'
            '            \'\';\r\n'
            '        final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '        ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '          \'diag_chat_open\',\r\n'
            '          conversationID: convID,\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'convType\': convType.name,\r\n'
            '            \'peerID\': peerID,\r\n'
            '            \'displayName\': displayName,\r\n'
            '            \'openGeneration\': generation,\r\n'
            '            \'im06ScopeConfigured\': globalModel.im06WriterScopeConfigured,\r\n'
            '            \'im06ScopeOwnerUserID\': globalModel.im06WriterOwnerUserID ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '            \'im06AccountGen\': globalModel.im06WriterAccountGeneration ?? -1,\r\n'
            '            \'im06DomainGen\': globalModel.im06WriterDomainGeneration ?? -1,\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {\r\n'
            '        // 诊断日志失败不影响主链路。\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // The remote gate protects only the route\'s first frame. Release it\r\n'
            '      // independently from scroll position so an early upward gesture can\r\n'
            '      // always fall through from the local SDK cache to cloud pagination.\r\n'
            '      _chatController.model?.allowRemoteHistoryAfterFirstFrame();\r\n'
            '      // History verification is the only automatic cloud history task after\r\n'
            '      // the first frame. Older group history is loaded only when the user\r\n'
            '      // scrolls upward; do not proactively backfill a time window.\r\n'
            '      final conversationKey = _getConvID()?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (conversationKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '      final completeLocalWindow =\r\n'
            '          ConversationPreviewHistorySync.isCompleteOpenHistoryWindow(\r\n'
            '        globalModel: globalModel,\r\n'
            '        conversationKey: conversationKey,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      // Thin snapshots need history just as urgently as empty ones. Only a\r\n'
            '      // complete first window can defer verification without delaying reveal.\r\n'
            '      final previewAhead = ConversationPreviewHistorySync.isPreviewAheadOfCachedHistory(\r\n'
            '        preview: _conversation.lastMessage,\r\n'
            '        cached: globalModel.rawMessageList(conversationKey) ?? const <V2TimMessage>[],\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      final delay = completeLocalWindow && !previewAhead\r\n'
            '          ? const Duration(milliseconds: 700)\r\n'
            '          : Duration.zero;\r\n'
            '      final verification = _runDeferredHistoryVerification(\r\n'
            '        generation: generation,\r\n'
            '        conversationKey: conversationKey,\r\n'
            '        delay: delay,\r\n'
            '        logTrace: ChatOpenPerfLog.captureCurrent(\r\n'
            '          conversationKey: conversationKey,\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      // Media prefetch runs after history verification so it cannot compete\r\n'
            '      // with the first cloud recovery request for the same conversation.\r\n'
            '      unawaited(verification.whenComplete(() {\r\n'
            '        if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '            generation != _chatOpenPhaseGeneration ||\r\n'
            '            !_isCurrentConversation(_resolvedConversationID())) {\r\n'
            '          return;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        unawaited(_prefetchMediaByType());\r\n'
            '      }));\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// K.4：异步分批预取媒体（图片/视频），避免阻塞首屏。\r\n'
            '  /// 不修改全局 store，仅通过 SDK 拉取并交给现有 messageListProjection 链路。\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _prefetchMediaByType() async {\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      final model = _chatController.model;\r\n'
            '      final conv = _conversation;\r\n'
            '      if (model == null || conv == null) return;\r\n'
            '      final convID = _getConvID()?.trim();\r\n'
            '      if (convID == null || convID.isEmpty) return;\r\n'
            '      // 取当前内存中最早一条作为锚点。\r\n'
            '      final list = model.globalModel.getMessageList(convID);\r\n'
            '      if (list == null || list.isEmpty) return;\r\n'
            '      final tail = list.last;\r\n'
            '      if (tail.msgID == null) return;\r\n'
            '      // SDK API：getHistoryMessageList（带 messageTypeList）。\r\n'
            '      final sdk = TencentImSDKPlugin.v2TIMManager.getMessageManager();\r\n'
            '      // conv.type 是 int? 类型，参考 Tencent IM SDK 枚举：\r\n'
            '      //   1 = C2C, 2 = Group\r\n'
            '      final convType = conv.type ?? 0;\r\n'
            '      await sdk.getHistoryMessageList(\r\n'
            '        getType: HistoryMsgGetTypeEnum.V2TIM_GET_CLOUD_OLDER_MSG,\r\n'
            '        userID: convType == 1 ? convID : null,\r\n'
            '        groupID: convType == 2 ? convID : null,\r\n'
            '        count: ConversationPerfFlags.groupHistorySdkPageSize,\r\n'
            '        lastMsgID: tail.msgID,\r\n'
            '        messageTypeList: const <int>[\r\n'
            '          2, // V2TIMMessageType.image\r\n'
            '          4, // V2TIMMessageType.video\r\n'
            '        ],\r\n'
            '      ).timeout(ConversationPerfFlags.groupHistorySdkTimeout);\r\n'
            '      // 数据通过 SDK 内部通道进入本地缓存；上层不直接消费。\r\n'
            '    } catch (_) {\r\n'
            '      // 预取失败不影响主链路\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  final Set<String> _pendingDeferredHistoryVerifications = <String>{};\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _runDeferredHistoryVerification({\r\n'
            '    required int generation,\r\n'
            '    required String conversationKey,\r\n'
            '    required Duration delay,\r\n'
            '    required ChatOpenTraceContext logTrace,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    final key = \'$generation|$conversationKey\';\r\n'
            '    if (!_pendingDeferredHistoryVerifications.add(key)) return;\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      await _performDeferredHistoryVerification(\r\n'
            '        generation: generation,\r\n'
            '        conversationKey: conversationKey,\r\n'
            '        delay: delay,\r\n'
            '        logTrace: logTrace,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    } finally {\r\n'
            '      _pendingDeferredHistoryVerifications.remove(key);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _performDeferredHistoryVerification({\r\n'
            '    required int generation,\r\n'
            '    required String conversationKey,\r\n'
            '    required Duration delay,\r\n'
            '    required ChatOpenTraceContext logTrace,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    if (delay > Duration.zero) {\r\n'
            '      await Future<void>.delayed(delay);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '        generation != _chatOpenPhaseGeneration ||\r\n'
            '        !_isCurrentConversation(_resolvedConversationID())) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // P1-1: 软 TTL — 同会话 N 秒内已 verify 过 → 直接 outcome=verified 跳过。\r\n'
            '    // 不影响切到其它会话再切回来的场景（TTL 过期后重新 verify）。\r\n'
            '    // 使用开区间：now - lastAt ≤ ttlMs 时跳过。\r\n'
            '    final now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\r\n'
            '    final lastAt = _lastCloudVerifyAtMs[conversationKey] ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    final previewAhead = await _conversationPreviewAheadOfHistory();\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || generation != _chatOpenPhaseGeneration) return;\r\n'
            '    final resetService = ChatLatestWindowResetService.instance;\r\n'
            '    if (resetService.needsLatestWindowReset(conversationKey) ||\r\n'
            '        resetService.isResetInFlight(conversationKey)) {\r\n'
            '      // A real reconnect invalidated this conversation\'s latest window. The\r\n'
            '      // reset service owns the cloud request; neither the stale verify TTL\r\n'
            '      // nor an ordinary verify pass may run alongside it.\r\n'
            '      ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '        \'chat_open_cloud_verify_deferred_done\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: conversationKey,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\'outcome\': \'latest_window_reset_owner\'},\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!previewAhead && lastAt > 0 && now - lastAt <= _cloudVerifySoftTtlMs) {\r\n'
            '      ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '        \'chat_open_cloud_verify_soft_skip\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: conversationKey,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'ageMs\': now - lastAt,\r\n'
            '          \'ttlMs\': _cloudVerifySoftTtlMs,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '        \'chat_open_cloud_verify_deferred_done\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: conversationKey,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\'outcome\': \'soft_ttl_skip\'},\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '    while (globalModel.isChatListUserScrolling ||\r\n'
            '        globalModel.getMessageListPosition(_resolvedConversationID()) !=\r\n'
            '            HistoryMessagePosition.bottom) {\r\n'
            '      ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '        \'chat_open_cloud_verify_requeued_by_user_state\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: conversationKey,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      // Keep exactly one bounded retry alive while this route is current.\r\n'
            '      // Returning to the newest edge will eventually run verification; if the\r\n'
            '      // user keeps reading older history, explicit pagination remains enabled.\r\n'
            '      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 700));\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '          generation != _chatOpenPhaseGeneration ||\r\n'
            '          !_isCurrentConversation(_resolvedConversationID())) return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '      \'chat_open_cloud_verify_deferred_start\',\r\n'
            '      conversationID: conversationKey,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'rawCount\': globalModel.rawMessageCount(conversationKey),\r\n'
            '        \'mayHaveOlder\': globalModel.mayHaveOlderHistory(conversationKey),\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '      trace: logTrace,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final verificationIdentity = SessionIdentityService.instance.capture();\r\n'
            '    final latestPreview = await _fetchConversationPreviewLastMessage();\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '        generation != _chatOpenPhaseGeneration ||\r\n'
            '        !SessionIdentityService.instance.isCurrent(verificationIdentity)) return;\r\n'
            '    final verificationConversation =\r\n'
            '        V2TimConversation.fromJson(_conversation.toJson())\r\n'
            '          ..lastMessage = latestPreview;\r\n'
            '    final outcome =\r\n'
            '        await ConversationHistorySyncCoordinator.instance.verifyAfterFirstFrame(\r\n'
            '      conversation: verificationConversation,\r\n'
            '      reason: \'chat_open\',\r\n'
            '      delay: Duration.zero,\r\n'
            '      logTrace: logTrace,\r\n'
            '      boundOpenGeneration: _viewportOpenGeneration,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // P1-1: 验证完成 → 记 lastAt，下一次进入走软 TTL。\r\n'
            '    // 只有 server sync 已完成且传输在线时，这次 verified 才有资格写 TTL；\r\n'

            '        generation: schedulerGeneration,\r\n'
            '        key: \'local_foundation\',\r\n'
            '        delay: Duration.zero,\r\n'

            '        task: () async {\r\n'
            '          await Future.wait<void>(<Future<void>>[\r\n'

            '        final groupId = ChatIdFormat.normalizeGroupId(\r\n'

            '            _markChatOpenBackgroundPart(\r\n'
            '              part: \'c2c\',\r\n'
            '              generation: taskGeneration,\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '            return;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          await _runOpenGroupMetadataEnrichment(\r\n'
            '            generation: taskGeneration,\r\n'
            '            canRun: canRun,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _postOpenScheduler.schedule(\r\n'
            '        generation: schedulerGeneration,\r\n'
            '        key: \'business_enrichment\',\r\n'
            '        delay: const Duration(milliseconds: 650),\r\n'
            '        priority: ChatTaskPriority.background,\r\n'
            '        canRun: canRun,\r\n'
            '        task: () async {\r\n'
            '          if (!canRun()) return;\r\n'
            '          await Future.wait<void>(<Future<void>>[\r\n'
            '            _loadGroupGameStatus(),\r\n'
            '            _loadAgentRebateIdentity(),\r\n'
            '            _loadSangongAgentEntry(),\r\n'
            '            _loadGroupLiveCurrent(),\r\n'
            '          ]);\r\n'
            '          if (canRun()) {\r\n'
            '            _markChatOpenBackgroundPart(\r\n'
            '              part: \'group_game\',\r\n'
            '              generation: taskGeneration,\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '            if (_getConvType() == ConvType.group) {\r\n'

            '        delay: ChatPostOpenScheduler.idleDelay,\r\n'
            '        priority: ChatTaskPriority.background,\r\n'
            '        canRun: canRun,\r\n'

            '      _postOpenScheduler.schedule(\r\n'
            '        generation: schedulerGeneration,\r\n'
            '        key: \'group_feature_idle\',\r\n'
            '        delay: const Duration(milliseconds: 900),\r\n'
            '        priority: ChatTaskPriority.background,\r\n'
            '        canRun: canRun,\r\n'

            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'

            '      if (animation != null && !animation.isCompleted) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  Future<({bool changed, bool didAttemptCloud})> _pullLatestMessagesFromAnchor({\r\n'
            '    required TUIChatSeparateViewModel model,\r\n'
            '    required String source,\r\n'
            '    bool allowCloudPull = true,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'

            '    final convKey = _getConvID()?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'

            '    final anchorId = _resolveLatestPullAnchorId();\r\n'
            '    if (anchorId.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        ConversationPreviewHistorySync.isSyntheticLocalAnchorId(anchorId)) {\r\n'
            '      // Synthetic anchor (group tip / call bubble): try to find a real SDK\r\n'
            '      // message in memory to use as cloud cursor. If none, full reload.\r\n'
            '      final realAnchor = HistoryPaginationAnchor.oldestSdkPaginationAnchor(\r\n'
            '        globalModel.mergedAliasMessageList(_resolvedConversationID()),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (realAnchor != null && (realAnchor.msgID ?? \'\').isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '          \'anchor_synthetic_replaced\',\r\n'
            '          source: source,\r\n'
            '          conversationID: _resolvedConversationID(),\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'syntheticAnchor\': anchorId,\r\n'
            '            \'realAnchor\': realAnchor.msgID,\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        return _pullFromRealAnchor(\r\n'
            '          model: model,\r\n'
            '          source: source,\r\n'
            '          anchorId: realAnchor.msgID!,\r\n'
            '          allowCloudPull: allowCloudPull,\r\n'
            '          beforeSignature: beforeSignature,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '        \'anchor_skip_synthetic_local\',\r\n'
            '        source: source,\r\n'
            '        conversationID: _resolvedConversationID(),\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\'anchorMsgID\': anchorId},\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _clearMountedDisplayListCache();\r\n'
            '      await _chatController.refreshCurrentHistoryList();\r\n'
            '      final changed = beforeSignature != _visibleHistorySignature();\r\n'
            '      return (changed: changed, didAttemptCloud: false);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (anchorId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return _pullFromRealAnchor(\r\n'
            '        model: model,\r\n'
            '        source: source,\r\n'
            '        anchorId: anchorId,\r\n'
            '        allowCloudPull: allowCloudPull,\r\n'
            '        beforeSignature: beforeSignature,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_hasVisibleHistoryMessages()) {\r\n'
            '      await model.loadChatRecord(\r\n'
            '        count: 20,\r\n'
            '        getType: HistoryMsgGetTypeEnum.V2TIM_GET_LOCAL_OLDER_MSG,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (beforeSignature != _visibleHistorySignature()) {\r\n'
            '        return (changed: true, didAttemptCloud: false);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      await model.loadChatRecord(\r\n'
            '        count: 20,\r\n'
            '        getType: HistoryMsgGetTypeEnum.V2TIM_GET_CLOUD_OLDER_MSG,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      final changed = beforeSignature != _visibleHistorySignature();\r\n'
            '      return (changed: changed, didAttemptCloud: true);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return (changed: false, didAttemptCloud: false);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Pull newer messages from a real SDK anchor. LOCAL_NEWER does NOT\r\n'
            '  /// short-circuit CLOUD_NEWER: both are executed so cloud-only messages\r\n'
            '  /// (not yet in local DB) are not missed.\r\n'
            '  Future<({bool changed, bool didAttemptCloud})> _pullFromRealAnchor({\r\n'
            '    required TUIChatSeparateViewModel model,\r\n'
            '    required String source,\r\n'
            '    required String anchorId,\r\n'
            '    required bool allowCloudPull,\r\n'
            '    required String beforeSignature,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    bool localChanged = false;\r\n'
            '    await model.loadChatRecord(\r\n'
            '      count: 20,\r\n'
            '      lastMsgID: anchorId,\r\n'
            '      direction: LoadDirection.latest,\r\n'
            '      getType: HistoryMsgGetTypeEnum.V2TIM_GET_LOCAL_NEWER_MSG,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (beforeSignature != _visibleHistorySignature()) {\r\n'
            '      localChanged = true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Do NOT short-circuit: continue to CLOUD_NEWER even if LOCAL_NEWER\r\n'
            '    // found changes, because cloud may have messages not yet in local DB.\r\n'
            '    bool cloudChanged = false;\r\n'
            '    bool didAttemptCloud = false;\r\n'
            '    if (allowCloudPull) {\r\n'
            '      didAttemptCloud = true;\r\n'
            '      final beforeRawLen = model.globalModel.rawMessageCount(\r\n'
            '        _resolvedConversationID(),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      await model.loadChatRecord(\r\n'
            '        count: 20,\r\n'
            '        lastMsgID: anchorId,\r\n'
            '        direction: LoadDirection.latest,\r\n'
            '        getType: HistoryMsgGetTypeEnum.V2TIM_GET_CLOUD_NEWER_MSG,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (beforeSignature != _visibleHistorySignature()) {\r\n'
            '        cloudChanged = true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // A large cloud delta is not a reason to rebuild the entire group\r\n'
            '      // history. The SDK already returned the messages and the normal\r\n'
            '      // persistence path will retain them; leave older, not-yet-requested\r\n'
            '      // history for explicit upward pagination.\r\n'
            '      final afterRawLen = model.globalModel.rawMessageCount(\r\n'
            '        _resolvedConversationID(),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (afterRawLen - beforeRawLen >= 60) {\r\n'
            '        ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '          \'recovery_difference_too_long\',\r\n'
            '          source: source,\r\n'
            '          conversationID: _resolvedConversationID(),\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'beforeLen\': beforeRawLen,\r\n'
            '            \'afterLen\': afterRawLen,\r\n'
            '            \'delta\': afterRawLen - beforeRawLen,\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        final changed = beforeSignature != _visibleHistorySignature();\r\n'
            '        return (changed: changed, didAttemptCloud: didAttemptCloud);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!localChanged && !cloudChanged) {\r\n'
            '      ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '        \'anchor_invalid_local\',\r\n'
            '        source: source,\r\n'
            '        conversationID: _resolvedConversationID(),\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\'anchorMsgID\': anchorId},\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _clearMountedDisplayListCache();\r\n'
            '      await _chatController.refreshCurrentHistoryList();\r\n'
            '      final changed = beforeSignature != _visibleHistorySignature();\r\n'
            '      return (changed: changed, didAttemptCloud: didAttemptCloud);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return (\r\n'
            '      changed: localChanged || cloudChanged,\r\n'
            '      didAttemptCloud: didAttemptCloud,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<bool> _mergePreviewMessageIfMissing() async {\r\n'
            '    // Conversation previews are summaries, not authoritative chat messages.\r\n'
            '    // Official Tencent IM conversations must wait for SDK history; otherwise a\r\n'
            '    // preview stub can appear as a fake/duplicate bubble.\r\n'
            '    final historyModel = _chatController.model;\r\n'
            '    if (historyModel?.usesOfficialSdkHistory == true) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final preview = await _fetchConversationPreviewLastMessage();\r\n'
            '    if (preview == null) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'

            '    final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '    final convKey = _getConvID()?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (convKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final existing =\r\n'
            '        globalModel.messageListMap[convKey] ?? const <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '    // bootstrap / peek 已灌窗：禁止再 merge 会话 preview stub（常缺 seq/msgID/textElem）。\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.hasInitialHistoryLoaded(convKey) && existing.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      ChatDiagLog.log(\r\n'
            '        \'ChatHistory\',\r\n'
            '        \'skip_preview_merge_warm_loaded\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: _resolvedConversationID(),\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'existingLen\': existing.length,\r\n'
            '          \'previewMsgId\': preview.msgID ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '          \'previewTs\': preview.timestamp ?? 0,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (existing.any(\r\n'
            '      (item) => TUIChatGlobalModel.messagesCorrelateForDedup(item, preview),\r\n'
            '    )) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isMessageVisibleInHistory(preview)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 本地 tip 不能灌进空聊天页，否则会连带触发 tip 历史整库回灌。\r\n'
            '    if (ConversationPreviewHistorySync.isSyntheticLocalMessage(preview)) {\r\n'
            '      ChatDiagLog.log(\r\n'
            '        \'ChatHistory\',\r\n'
            '        \'skip_preview_merge_local_tip\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: _resolvedConversationID(),\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\'previewMsgId\': preview.msgID ?? \'\'},\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (GroupTipsMessageHelper.isGroupCreateRedundantWithHistory(\r\n'
            '      preview,\r\n'
            '      _visibleHistoryMessagesForExternalEntry(),\r\n'
            '    )) {\r\n'
            '      ChatDiagLog.log(\r\n'
            '        \'ChatHistory\',\r\n'
            '        \'skip_preview_merge_group_create\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: _resolvedConversationID(),\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\'previewMsgId\': preview.msgID ?? \'\'},\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final merged = TUIChatGlobalModel.mergeHistoricalWithInMemory(\r\n'
            '      existing: existing,\r\n'
            '      fetched: <V2TimMessage>[preview],\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    globalModel.commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '      MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '        conversationKey: convKey,\r\n'
            '        eventID: \'preview_merge:${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}\',\r\n'
            '        kind: MessageDeltaKind.optimisticAdoption,\r\n'
            '        source: MessageDeltaSource.historyEnvelope,\r\n'
            '        generation: globalModel.messageDeltaGenerationFor(convKey),\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch: globalModel.messageDeltaClearEpochFor(convKey),\r\n'
            '        replace: true,\r\n'
            '        upserts: merged.map(globalModel.messageDeltaRecord),\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'

            '      ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '        \'history_recovery_delegated_latest_window_reset\',\r\n'
            '        source: source,\r\n'
            '        conversationID: conversationID,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'hasMessagesBefore\': hasMessages,\r\n'
            '          \'epoch\': ImConnectStatusService.recoveryEpoch,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _armLatestWindowResetWhenAtBottom(reason: source);\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final previewAheadForDelays =\r\n'
            '        isRecovery ? await _conversationPreviewAheadOfHistory() : false;\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final retryDelays = _resolveRecoveryRetryDelays(\r\n'
            '      source,\r\n'
            '      hasVisibleMessages: hasMessages,\r\n'
            '      previewAhead: previewAheadForDelays,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // 清空聊天记录触发的激活（进页 initState 走到这里，绕过了 bus 监听里的\r\n'
            '    // clear 短路）：会话已确认为空（无内存消息、预览也为空）时直接标记\r\n'
            '    // empty-loaded 收工。否则 legacy「latest/local/cloud/refresh」四连拉\r\n'
            '    // × 多轮重试会对一个已知为空的会话产生十余次无效 setMessageList。\r\n'
            '    if (source == \'conversation_clear_history\' && !hasMessages) {\r\n'
            '      final preview = await _fetchConversationPreviewLastMessage();\r\n'

            '        final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '        for (final key in <String>{\r\n'
            '          convKey,\r\n'

            '          ChatHistoryRefreshBus.instance.lastConversationId?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (current.isEmpty || !_matchesRefreshConversationId(target)) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final previewAhead =\r\n'
            '          isRecovery ? await _conversationPreviewAheadOfHistory() : false;\r\n'
            '      final anchorMsgID =\r\n'
            '          isRecovery ? _resolveLatestPullAnchorId() : _latestVisibleMessageId();\r\n'
            '      ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '        \'history_activation_attempt\',\r\n'
            '        source: source,\r\n'
            '        conversationID: current,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'attempt\': index + 1,\r\n'
            '          \'delayMs\': delay.inMilliseconds,\r\n'
            '          \'hasMessagesBefore\': hasMessages,\r\n'
            '          \'previewAhead\': previewAhead,\r\n'
            '          \'anchorMsgID\': anchorMsgID,\r\n'
            '          \'recoveryReason\': isRecovery ? source : null,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      final model = _chatController.model;\r\n'
            '      if (model == null) {\r\n'
            '        ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '          \'history_activation_wait_model\',\r\n'
            '          source: source,\r\n'
            '          conversationID: current,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        if (isRecovery) {\r\n'
            '          final shouldAllowCloudCatchUp = warm_resume.shouldAllowCloudCatchUp(\r\n'
            '            source: source,\r\n'
            '            previewAhead: previewAhead,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '          final pullResult = await _pullLatestMessagesFromAnchor(\r\n'
            '            model: model,\r\n'
            '            source: source,\r\n'
            '            allowCloudPull: shouldAllowCloudCatchUp,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '          final changed = pullResult.changed;\r\n'
            '          hasMessages = _hasVisibleHistoryMessages();\r\n'
            '          ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '            \'history_recovery_pull_done\',\r\n'
            '            source: source,\r\n'
            '            conversationID: current,\r\n'
            '            extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '              \'changed\': changed,\r\n'

            '              \'previewAhead\': previewAhead,\r\n'
            '              \'anchorMsgID\': anchorMsgID,\r\n'
            '              \'shouldAllowCloudCatchUp\': shouldAllowCloudCatchUp,\r\n'

            '          final recoveryGlobalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '          final recoveryConvKey = _getConvID()?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '          final hasDeferredIncoming = recoveryConvKey.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
