            '            hasMessages: hasMessages,\r\n'
            '            previewAhead: previewAhead,\r\n'
            '            hasDeferredIncoming: hasDeferredIncoming,\r\n'
            '            cloudCatchUpRequired: shouldAllowCloudCatchUp && !previewAhead,\r\n'
            '            cloudCatchUpAttempted: pullResult.didAttemptCloud,\r\n'
            '          )) {\r\n'
            '            final savedDelayMs = retryDelays\r\n'
            '                .skip(index + 1)\r\n'
            '                .fold<int>(0, (sum, delay) => sum + delay.inMilliseconds);\r\n'
            '            ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '              \'history_recovery_skip_satisfied\',\r\n'
            '              source: source,\r\n'
            '              conversationID: current,\r\n'
            '              extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '                \'attempt\': index + 1,\r\n'
            '                \'recoveryReason\': source,\r\n'
            '                \'savedDelayMs\': savedDelayMs,\r\n'
            '              },\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '            if (!previewAhead) {\r\n'
            '              _recordRecoverySuccess();\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '            _publishExternalEntryState();\r\n'
            '            return;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          final convKey = _getConvID()?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '          final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '          if (hasMessages &&\r\n'
            '              convKey.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '              globalModel.hasInitialHistoryLoaded(convKey)) {\r\n'
            '            // Cloud catch-up required: only arm the 30s skip window after an\r\n'
            '            // allowed cloud pull with no deferred gap left. Otherwise fall\r\n'
            '            // through to preview-merge / retries (do not record success).\r\n'
            '            final cloudCatchUpRequired =\r\n'
            '                shouldAllowCloudCatchUp && !previewAhead;\r\n'
            '            final mayMarkSuccess =\r\n'
            '                cloudCatchUpRequired ? !hasDeferredIncoming : true;\r\n'
            '            ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '              \'history_recovery_skip_preview_merge_warm\',\r\n'
            '              source: source,\r\n'
            '              conversationID: current,\r\n'
            '              extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '                \'previewAhead\': previewAhead,\r\n'
            '                \'anchorMsgID\': anchorMsgID,\r\n'
            '                \'rawLen\': globalModel.rawMessageCount(convKey),\r\n'
            '                \'shouldAllowCloudCatchUp\': shouldAllowCloudCatchUp,\r\n'
            '                \'mayMarkSuccess\': mayMarkSuccess,\r\n'
            '              },\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '            if (mayMarkSuccess) {\r\n'
            '              if (!previewAhead) {\r\n'
            '                _recordRecoverySuccess();\r\n'
            '              }\r\n'
            '              _publishExternalEntryState();\r\n'
            '              return;\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          if (await _mergePreviewMessageIfMissing()) {\r\n'
            '            hasMessages = _hasVisibleHistoryMessages();\r\n'
            '            ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '              \'history_preview_merge_done\',\r\n'
            '              source: source,\r\n'
            '              conversationID: current,\r\n'
            '              extras: <String, Object?>{\'hasMessages\': hasMessages},\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '            // Splicing the preview tip into a window that was behind it is\r\n'
            '            // not a continuous recovery; do not arm the 30s skip window.\r\n'
            '            _publishExternalEntryState();\r\n'
            '            return;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          if (index + 1 >= retryDelays.length) {\r\n'
            '            try {\r\n'
            '              await _chatController.refreshCurrentHistoryList();\r\n'
            '              hasMessages = _hasVisibleHistoryMessages();\r\n'
            '              if (hasMessages) {\r\n'
            '                _publishExternalEntryState();\r\n'
            '                return;\r\n'
            '              }\r\n'
            '            } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          continue;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '        final beforeSignature = _visibleHistorySignature();\r\n'
            '        final changed = await _refreshChatHistoryLegacyFallback(\r\n'
            '          model: model,\r\n'
            '          source: source,\r\n'
            '          current: current,\r\n'
            '          beforeSignature: beforeSignature,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        hasMessages = _hasVisibleHistoryMessages();\r\n'
            '        if (changed) {\r\n'
            '          _publishExternalEntryState();\r\n'
            '          return;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } catch (e) {\r\n'
            '        ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '          \'history_activation_error\',\r\n'
            '          source: source,\r\n'
            '          conversationID: current,\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'error\': e.toString(),\r\n'
            '            \'recoveryReason\': isRecovery ? source : null,\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        if (!isRecovery) {\r\n'
            '          try {\r\n'
            '            await _chatController.refreshCurrentHistoryList();\r\n'
            '            hasMessages = _hasVisibleHistoryMessages();\r\n'
            '            ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '              \'history_error_fallback_done\',\r\n'
            '              source: source,\r\n'
            '              conversationID: current,\r\n'
            '              extras: <String, Object?>{\'hasMessages\': hasMessages},\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '            if (hasMessages) {\r\n'
            '              _publishExternalEntryState();\r\n'
            '              return;\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '          } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '        } else if (index + 1 >= retryDelays.length) {\r\n'
            '          try {\r\n'
            '            await _chatController.refreshCurrentHistoryList();\r\n'
            '            hasMessages = _hasVisibleHistoryMessages();\r\n'
            '            if (hasMessages) {\r\n'
            '              _publishExternalEntryState();\r\n'
            '              return;\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '          } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    ExternalChatEntryService.instance.logFlow(\r\n'
            '      \'history_activation_finished\',\r\n'
            '      source: source,\r\n'
            '      conversationID: conversationID,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'hasMessages\': hasMessages,\r\n'
            '        \'recoveryReason\': isRecovery ? source : null,\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _publishExternalEntryState();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _clearMountedDisplayListCache() {\r\n'
            '    _mountedDisplayListCache = null;\r\n'
            '    _mountedDisplayInputCache = null;\r\n'
            '    _mountedDisplayListLen = 0;\r\n'
            '    _mountedDisplayInputSignature = \'\';\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  String _messageMountIdentity(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    final msgID = message.msgID?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (msgID != null && msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return msgID;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final id = message.id?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (id != null && id.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return id;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final seq = message.seq?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (seq != null && seq.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'seq:$seq\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return \'${message.timestamp}_${message.random}_${message.sender}\';\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _mountedDisplayListsMatchPrefix(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> current,\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> cached,\r\n'
            '    int cachedLen,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (current.length <= cachedLen || cached.length != cachedLen) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < cachedLen; i++) {\r\n'
            '      if (!identical(current[i], cached[i])) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _mountedDisplayListsMatchSuffix(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> current,\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> cached,\r\n'
            '    int cachedLen,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (current.length <= cachedLen || cached.length != cachedLen) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final delta = current.length - cachedLen;\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < cachedLen; i++) {\r\n'
            '      if (!identical(current[delta + i], cached[i])) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _messageLooksLikeCallForMount(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (_localCallBubbleMarker(message) != null) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return CallingMessageDataProvider.looksLikeCallMessage(message);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _isLegacyLocalCallBubble(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    return _localCallBubbleMarker(message) != null;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _mountedDisplayListsShareInstances(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> current,\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> cached,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (current.length != cached.length) return false;\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < current.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      if (!identical(current[i], cached[i])) return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  List<V2TimMessage> _normalizeMessageListForMount(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> messageList,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (messageList.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _clearMountedDisplayListCache();\r\n'
            '      return messageList;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final cached = _mountedDisplayListCache;\r\n'
            '    final cachedInput = _mountedDisplayInputCache;\r\n'
            '    final conversationKey = _resolvedConversationID();\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = serviceLocator<TUIChatGlobalModel>();\r\n'
            '    final shouldClampGroup = _getConvType() == ConvType.group &&\r\n'
            '        globalModel.getMessageListPosition(conversationKey) ==\r\n'
            '            HistoryMessagePosition.bottom &&\r\n'
            '        !globalModel.isChatListUserScrolling;\r\n'
            '    final inputSignature =\r\n'
            '        \'${TUIChatGlobalModel.messageListProjectionSignature(messageList)}\'\r\n'
            '        \'|clamp:$shouldClampGroup:${ConversationPerfFlags.groupHistoryMemoryWindowLimit}\';\r\n'
            '    if (cached != null &&\r\n'
            '        cachedInput != null &&\r\n'
            '        _mountedDisplayInputSignature == inputSignature &&\r\n'
            '        _mountedDisplayListsShareInstances(messageList, cachedInput)) {\r\n'
            '      return cached;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final canonicalText =\r\n'
            '        TUIChatGlobalModel.isCanonicalPlainTextProjection(messageList);\r\n'
            '    // Normalize application-specific identities once. Complete SDK messages\r\n'
            '    // (including mixed media/custom rows) already have distinct protocol\r\n'
            '    // identities, so the canonical projection helper reuses their order.\r\n'
            '    final hasCalls =\r\n'
            '        !canonicalText && messageList.any(_messageLooksLikeCallForMount);\r\n'
            '    final normalized =\r\n'
            '        hasCalls ? _normalizeCallHistoryMessages(messageList) : messageList;\r\n'
            '    _normalizeSelfMessageAvatars(normalized);\r\n'
            '    var sorted = canonicalText\r\n'
            '        ? normalized\r\n'
            '        : TUIChatGlobalModel.canonicalizeMessageProjection(normalized);\r\n'
            '    if (!canonicalText) {\r\n'
            '      sorted = GroupTipsMessageHelper.applyPostMergeFilters(sorted);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Bound the mounted group-chat window. Older pages are fetched again from\r\n'
            '    // the SDK when the user scrolls upward; retaining the newest hot window\r\n'
            '    // keeps large groups from growing the widget tree without limit.\r\n'
            '    if (shouldClampGroup &&\r\n'
            '        sorted.length > ConversationPerfFlags.groupHistoryMemoryWindowLimit) {\r\n'
            '      sorted = sorted\r\n'
            '          .sublist(sorted.length -\r\n'
            '              ConversationPerfFlags.groupHistoryMemoryWindowLimit)\r\n'
            '          .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _mountedDisplayListCache = List<V2TimMessage>.from(sorted);\r\n'
            '    _mountedDisplayInputCache = List<V2TimMessage>.of(messageList);\r\n'
            '    _mountedDisplayListLen = sorted.length;\r\n'
            '    _mountedDisplayInputSignature = inputSignature;\r\n'
            '    return sorted;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  List<V2TimMessage> _normalizeCallHistoryMessages(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> messageList,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    return CallBubbleDedupe.normalizeCallHistoryMessages(\r\n'
            '      messageList,\r\n'
            '      preserveTipIdentity: true,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  String _callBubbleStableKey(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage message, {\r\n'
            '    _LocalCallBubbleMarker? marker,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final marked = marker ?? _localCallBubbleMarker(message);\r\n'
            '    if (marked != null && marked.callId.trim().isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'call:${marked.callId.trim()}\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 非展示态（invite/accept）不要生成 call:$id，避免挡住本地终态气泡。\r\n'
            '    if (!_shouldDisplayCallMessageInHistory(message)) {\r\n'
            '      return \'\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final unified = CallBubbleDedupe.c2cHangupKeyForMessage(message);\r\n'
            '    if (unified.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return unified;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final durationSec = _callBubbleDurationSec(message);\r\n'
            '    final roomId = CallBubbleDedupe.extractRoomId(message);\r\n'
            '    if (roomId.isNotEmpty && durationSec > 0) {\r\n'
            '      return \'call-room:$roomId:$durationSec\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final extracted = (_extractCallSignalInviteId(message) ?? \'\').trim();\r\n'
            '    if (extracted.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'call:$extracted\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      final provider = CallingMessageDataProvider(message);\r\n'
            '      if (provider.isCallingSignal && provider.shouldDisplayInHistory) {\r\n'
            '        return provider.callStableKey;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '    return \'\';\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  String _callBubbleNearDuplicateKey(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage message, {\r\n'
            '    _LocalCallBubbleMarker? marker,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final unified = CallBubbleDedupe.c2cHangupKeyForMessage(message);\r\n'
            '    if (unified.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return unified;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final marked = marker ?? _localCallBubbleMarker(message);\r\n'
            '    final inviteId = (_extractCallSignalInviteId(message) ?? \'\').trim();\r\n'
            '    final ts = message.timestamp ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    final bucket = ts <= 0 ? 0 : ts ~/ 60;\r\n'
            '    if (inviteId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'call-near:$inviteId:$bucket\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (marked != null && marked.callId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'call-near:${marked.callId}:$bucket\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return \'\';\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  String _conversationIdForCallBubbleMessage(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    final marker = _localCallBubbleMarker(message);\r\n'
            '    if (marker != null && marker.conversationId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return marker.conversationId;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'

            '        continue;\r\n'

            '      try {\r\n'
            '        final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);\r\n'
            '        if (decoded is! Map) {\r\n'
            '          continue;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        final direct = decoded[\'call_end\'] ?? decoded[\'callEnd\'];\r\n'
            '        if (direct is num && direct > 0) {\r\n'
            '          return direct.round();\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        final data = decoded[\'data\'];\r\n'
            '        if (data is String && data.trim().startsWith(\'{\')) {\r\n'
            '          final nested = jsonDecode(data);\r\n'
            '          if (nested is Map) {\r\n'
            '            final nestedEnd = nested[\'call_end\'] ?? nested[\'callEnd\'];\r\n'
            '            if (nestedEnd is num && nestedEnd > 0) {\r\n'

            '            }\r\n'

            '      message.cloudCustomData?.trim() ?? \'\',\r\n'
